```sql
WITH scoped AS (
    -- Filter tracks
    SELECT
        id,
        artist_id,
        title,
        is_explicit,
        moods,
        ADD_MONTHS(release_date, 12) AS release_date_plus_12m,
        CASE WHEN is_explicit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_explicit_flag,
        ABS(duration_sec - 352) AS duration_sec_distance
    FROM tracks
),
enriched_artist AS (
    -- Attach artist attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.artist_id,
        s.title,
        s.is_explicit,
        s.moods,
        s.duration_sec_distance,
        a.genre AS artist_genre
    FROM scoped s
    JOIN artists a ON a.id = s.artist_id
)
-- Subtotals with ROLLUP
SELECT
    artist_genre,
    is_explicit,
    artist_id,
    SUM(duration_sec_distance) FILTER (WHERE artist_genre IN ('Pop', 'HipHop', 'Jazz')) AS duration_sec_distance_artist_genre_in_pop_hiphop
FROM enriched_artist
GROUP BY ROLLUP(artist_genre, is_explicit, artist_id)
ORDER BY artist_genre NULLS LAST, is_explicit NULLS LAST, artist_id NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

scoped = (
    df_tracks
    .select(
        "id",
        "artist_id",
        "title",
        "is_explicit",
        "moods",
        F.add_months(F.col("release_date"), 12).alias("release_date_plus_12m"),
        F.when(F.col("is_explicit"), 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_explicit_flag"),
        F.abs(F.col("duration_sec") - 352).alias("duration_sec_distance"),
    )
)

enriched_artist = (
    scoped.alias("s")
    .join(df_artists.alias("a"), F.col("a.id") == F.col("s.artist_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.artist_id",
        "s.title",
        "s.is_explicit",
        "s.moods",
        "s.duration_sec_distance",
        F.col("a.genre").alias("artist_genre"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_artist
    .rollup("artist_genre", "is_explicit", "artist_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("artist_genre").isin("Pop", "HipHop", "Jazz"), F.col("duration_sec_distance"))).alias("duration_sec_distance_artist_genre_in_pop_hiphop"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("artist_genre").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("is_explicit").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("artist_id").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)
```

```sql
with enriched as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (partition by year(started_at), browser order by started_at, id) as row_seq,
        last_value(browser) ignore nulls over w_part as last_known_browser,
        last_value(browser) ignore nulls over (partition by device, customer_id order by started_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_browser_2
    from sessions
    where browser in ('Safari', 'Chrome')
    window w_part as (order by started_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when lag(started_at) over (partition by country order by started_at, id) is null
                 or started_at > lag(started_at) over (partition by country order by started_at, id) + interval 7 days then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst
    from enriched
),
sessionized as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        last_known_browser,
        last_known_browser_2,
        sum(is_new_burst) over (partition by country order by started_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_no
    from gaps
),
with_gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when lag(started_at) over (partition by browser order by started_at, id) is null
                 or started_at > lag(started_at) over (partition by browser order by started_at, id) + interval 7 days then 1 else 0 end as new_group_flag
    from sessionized
),
sessionized_sessions as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(new_group_flag) over (partition by browser order by started_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_id
    from with_gaps
),
prev_events as (
    -- Previous event time per key
    select *, lag(started_at) over (partition by country order by started_at, id) as prev_started_at
    from sessionized_sessions
),
gaps_2 as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    select *, case when prev_started_at is null or started_at > prev_started_at + interval 7 days then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session
    from prev_events
),
sessions_sessions as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_session) over (partition by country order by started_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_id_2
    from gaps_2
),
by_type as (
    -- Native SQL PIVOT
    select *
    from (
        select
            device,
            country,
            new_group_flag
        from sessions_sessions
    ) src
    pivot (
        max(new_group_flag)
        for country in ('TH', 'SG', 'DE')
    )
)
select
    device,
    DE,
    case when device rlike '^(mobile|tablet)$' then 'PRIORITY' else 'GROUP_B' end as device_zone
from by_type
order by DE;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

enriched = (
    df_sessions
    .filter(F.col("browser").isin(["Safari", "Chrome"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("started_at"), "browser").orderBy("started_at", "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.last("browser", ignorenulls=True).over(w_part).alias("last_known_browser"),
        F.last("browser", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("device", "customer_id").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_browser_2"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.lag("started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        "last_known_browser",
        "last_known_browser_2",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.lag("started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized_sessions = with_gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

prev_events = sessionized_sessions.withColumn("prev_started_at", F.lag("started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id")))

gaps_2 = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_started_at").isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.col("prev_started_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_sessions = gaps_2.withColumn("session_id_2", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

by_type = (
    sessions_sessions
    .groupBy("device")
    .pivot("country", ["TH", "SG", "DE"])
    .agg(F.max("new_group_flag"))
)

result = (
    by_type
    .select(
        "device",
        "DE",
        F.when(F.col("device").rlike("^(mobile|tablet)$"), "PRIORITY").otherwise("GROUP_B").alias("device_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy("DE")
)
```

```sql
WITH prev_events AS (SELECT *, LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id) AS prev_paid_at FROM payments), gaps AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_paid_at IS NULL OR paid_at > prev_paid_at + INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session FROM prev_events), sessionized AS (SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id FROM gaps) SELECT method, status, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids, COUNT(*) AS event_count, ROUND(AVG(island_id), 2) AS avg_island_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'REFUNDED') AS refunded_rows FROM sessionized GROUP BY method, status HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'REFUNDED') >= 1 ORDER BY distinct_ids DESC NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prev_events = df_payments.withColumn("prev_paid_at", F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id")))

gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_paid_at").isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.col("prev_paid_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

result = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("method", "status")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("island_id"), 2).alias("avg_island_id"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "REFUNDED", 1)).alias("refunded_rows"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("refunded_rows") >= 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("distinct_ids").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

```sql
WITH base AS (
    -- Filter meter_readings
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        voltage,
        quality,
        LOWER(TRIM(quality)) AS quality_clean
    FROM meter_readings
    WHERE kwh > 48.2
      AND quality IN ('OK', 'BAD')
),
exploded_detail_readings AS (
    -- One row per reading
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.site_id,
        s.kwh,
        s.quality,
        s.quality_clean,
        m.id AS reading_id,
        m.quality AS reading_quality,
        m.kwh AS reading_kwh,
        m.voltage AS reading_voltage,
        m.read_at AS reading_read_at
    FROM base s
    LEFT JOIN meter_readings m ON m.site_id = s.site_id
),
tagged AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(reading_quality), 1, 4) AS reading_quality_prefix,
        ABS(reading_voltage - 227.1) AS reading_voltage_distance,
        COALESCE(reading_voltage, 0.0) AS reading_voltage_filled
    FROM exploded_detail_readings
)
SELECT
    site_id,
    quality,
    reading_quality,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level,
    ROUND(SUM(reading_voltage_filled) / NULLIF(SUM(reading_voltage_distance), 0), 3) AS reading_voltage_filled_to_reading_voltage_distan,
    MIN(reading_voltage_filled) AS min_reading_voltage_filled,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM tagged
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((site_id, quality, reading_quality), (site_id), (quality), ())
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter((F.col("kwh") > 48.2) & (F.col("quality").isin("OK", "BAD")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.lower(F.trim(F.col("quality"))).alias("quality_clean"),
    )
)

exploded_detail_readings = (
    base.alias("s")
    .join(df_meter_readings.alias("m"), F.col("m.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.site_id",
        "s.kwh",
        "s.quality",
        "s.quality_clean",
        F.col("m.id").alias("reading_id"),
        F.col("m.quality").alias("reading_quality"),
        F.col("m.kwh").alias("reading_kwh"),
        F.col("m.voltage").alias("reading_voltage"),
        F.col("m.read_at").alias("reading_read_at"),
    )
)

tagged = (
    exploded_detail_readings
    .select(
        "*",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("reading_quality")), 1, 4).alias("reading_quality_prefix"),
        F.abs(F.col("reading_voltage") - 227.1).alias("reading_voltage_distance"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("reading_voltage"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("reading_voltage_filled"),
    )
)

result = (
    tagged
    .groupingSets(
        [["site_id", "quality", "reading_quality"], ["site_id"], ["quality"], []],
        "site_id", "quality", "reading_quality",
    )
    .agg(
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level"),
        F.round(F.sum("reading_voltage_filled") / F.nullif(F.sum("reading_voltage_distance"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("reading_voltage_filled_to_reading_voltage_distan"),
        F.min("reading_voltage_filled").alias("min_reading_voltage_filled"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
)
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
```
```python
    .drop("dedup_rank")

    .select(

)

)
```

```python
flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_event_at").isNull() | (F.col("event_at") > F.col("prev_event_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions = (

    .groupBy("event_type", "session_id")

windowed = (
    sessions
    .select(
        "event_type",
        "session_id",
        "session_start",
        "event_count",
        "duration_min",
        F.round(F.col("session_id") - F.avg("session_id").over(w_session_start_to_date_sessio), 2).alias("session_id_vs_session_start_to_date_session_id_a"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_count", "event_type", "session_id")).alias("event_count_dense_rank"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_count")), 3).alias("event_count_cume_dist"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_event_type_by_event_count_ti), 3).alias("event_count_percent_rank"),
        F.nth_value("session_id", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_count", "event_type", "session_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_session_id"),
```

```sql
WITH prepared AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        policy_id,
        adjuster_id,
        claimed_amount,
        approved_amount,
        reported_at,
        LENGTH(TRIM(claim_type)) AS claim_type_len
    FROM claims
    WHERE approved_amount <= 21750.2
      AND claim_type <> 'flood'
),
adjuster_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg claimed_amount per adjuster_id
    SELECT adjuster_id, AVG(claimed_amount) AS avg_claimed_amount
    FROM prepared
    GROUP BY adjuster_id
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_claimed_amount,
        ROUND(s.claimed_amount - g.avg_claimed_amount, 2) AS claimed_amount_minus_avg
    FROM prepared s
    JOIN adjuster_id_stats g ON g.adjuster_id = s.adjuster_id
    WHERE s.claimed_amount > g.avg_claimed_amount
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach claims metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MAX(c.claim_date) FROM claims c WHERE c.policy_id = s.policy_id) AS last_claim_date,
        (SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN c.claim_type IN ('theft', 'collision', 'flood') THEN 1 END) FROM claims c WHERE c.policy_id = s.policy_id) AS claim_claim_type_count
    FROM vs_group s
)
SELECT
    claim_claim_type_count,
    claim_type_len,
    policy_id,
    GROUPING(claim_claim_type_count) AS is_total_claim_claim_type_count,
    ROUND(STDDEV(approved_amount), 2) AS stddev_approved_amount,
    MIN(reported_at) AS first_reported_at,
    ROUND(STDDEV(avg_claimed_amount), 2) AS stddev_avg_claimed_amount
FROM summarized_rows
GROUP BY CUBE(claim_claim_type_count, claim_type_len, policy_id)
ORDER BY claim_claim_type_count NULLS LAST, claim_type_len NULLS LAST, policy_id NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

prepared = (
    df_claims
    .filter((F.col("approved_amount") <= 21750.2) & (F.col("claim_type") != "flood"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "policy_id",
        "adjuster_id",
        "claimed_amount",
        "approved_amount",
        "reported_at",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("claim_type"))).alias("claim_type_len"),
    )
)

adjuster_id_stats = (
    prepared
    .groupBy("adjuster_id")
    .agg(F.avg("claimed_amount").alias("avg_claimed_amount"))
)

vs_group = (
    prepared.alias("s")
    .join(adjuster_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.adjuster_id") == F.col("s.adjuster_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.claimed_amount") > F.col("g.avg_claimed_amount"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_claimed_amount",
        F.round(F.col("s.claimed_amount") - F.col("g.avg_claimed_amount"), 2).alias("claimed_amount_minus_avg"),
    )
)

claim_stats = (
    df_claims
    .groupBy("policy_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("claim_date").alias("last_claim_date"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("claim_type").isin("theft", "collision", "flood"), 1)).alias("claim_claim_type_count"),
    )
)

summarized_rows = (
    vs_group.alias("s")
    .join(claim_stats.alias("c"), F.col("c.policy_id") == F.col("s.policy_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "c.last_claim_date",
        F.coalesce(F.col("c.claim_claim_type_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("claim_claim_type_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    summarized_rows
    .cube("claim_claim_type_count", "claim_type_len", "policy_id")
    .agg(
        F.grouping("claim_claim_type_count").alias("is_total_claim_claim_type_count"),
        F.round(F.stddev("approved_amount"), 2).alias("stddev_approved_amount"),
        F.min("reported_at").alias("first_reported_at"),
        F.round(F.stddev("avg_claimed_amount"), 2).alias("stddev_avg_claimed_amount"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("claim_claim_type_count").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("claim_type_len").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("policy_id").asc_nulls_last(),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_claims
    .filter((F.col("approved_amount") >= 4234.9) & (F.col("policy_id") <= 15))
    .select(
        "id",
        "policy_id",
        "adjuster_id",
        "claimed_amount",
        "status",
        "reported_at",
    )
)

w_adjuster_id_policy_id_by_rep = Window.partitionBy("adjuster_id", "policy_id").orderBy("reported_at", "id")
metrics = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.avg("claimed_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("adjuster_id").orderBy(F.col("reported_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)), 2).alias("claimed_amount_avg_6_prior"),
        F.lead("reported_at", 3).over(Window.partitionBy("adjuster_id", "policy_id").orderBy("reported_at", "id")).alias("next3_reported_at"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("adjuster_id").orderBy(F.col("reported_at").desc(), "id")), 3).alias("reported_at_cume_dist"),
        F.sum("claimed_amount").over(Window.orderBy("claimed_amount", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("claimed_amount_sum_4"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.orderBy("claimed_amount", "id")).alias("claimed_amount_quartile"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_adjuster_id_policy_id_by_rep).alias("reported_at_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("claimed_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("adjuster_id").orderBy(F.col("reported_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("claimed_amount_sum_2_prior"),
        F.max("claimed_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("adjuster_id", "policy_id").orderBy("reported_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_claimed_amount_so_far"),
        F.sum("claimed_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("adjuster_id").orderBy(F.col("reported_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_claimed_amount"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy("claimed_amount", "id")), 3).alias("claimed_amount_percent_rank"),
        F.round(F.col("claimed_amount") - F.avg("claimed_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("policy_id")), 2).alias("claimed_amount_vs_policy_id_avg"),
        F.min("claimed_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("policy_id")).alias("policy_id_min_claimed_amount"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("adjuster_id", "policy_id").orderBy("reported_at")).alias("reported_at_dense_rank_2"),

leaders = metrics.filter(F.col("reported_at_dense_rank_2") <= 3)

with_windows = (
```

```python
        & (F.col("b.played_at") >= F.col("a.played_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")),
        "left",

    .select(
```

```python
        F.size(F.collect_set("listener_id").over(w_device)).alias("distinct_listener_id_in_device"),
        F.last("ms_played_distance").over(Window.partitionBy("device", "is_skipped").orderBy(F.col("ms_played_distance").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_ms_played_distance"),
        F.lead("ms_played_distance", 1, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("device", "is_skipped").orderBy(F.col("ms_played_distance").desc(), "id")).alias("next_ms_played_distance"),
        F.max("ms_played_distance").over(Window.partitionBy("listener_id", "track_id").orderBy(F.col("played_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("ms_played_distance_max_3_prior"),
        F.lead("played_at").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("played_at"), "is_skipped").orderBy(F.col("ms_played").desc(), "id")).alias("next_played_at"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    sequenced
    .select(
        "*",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("device")), 1, 4).alias("device_prefix"),
        F.lower(F.trim(F.col("device"))).alias("device_clean"),
        F.greatest(F.col("next_ms_played_distance"), F.col("last_ms_played_distance")).alias("greatest_next_ms_played_distance_last_ms_played_"),
    )
)

w_distinct_listener_id_in_devi_2 = Window.partitionBy("distinct_listener_id_in_device").orderBy(F.col("greatest_next_ms_played_distance_last_ms_played_").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
sequenced_2 = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last("next_ms_played_distance", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("distinct_listener_id_in_device").orderBy(F.col("greatest_next_ms_played_distance_last_ms_played_").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_next_ms_played_distance"),

result = (
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped = (
    df_ticket_events
    .filter(F.col("ticket_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("actor"))).alias("actor_len"),
    )
)

w_ticket_id_actor_by_event_at = Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", "actor").orderBy(F.col("event_at").asc_nulls_last())
w_actor_len_ticket_id = Window.partitionBy("actor_len", "ticket_id")
w_event_type_actor_by_event_at = Window.partitionBy("event_type", "actor").orderBy("event_at", "id")
w_actor_len_event_type_by_even_2 = Window.partitionBy("actor_len", "event_type").orderBy(F.col("event_at").desc(), "id")
w_ticket_id_by_actor_len = Window.partitionBy("ticket_id").orderBy("actor_len", "id")
windowed = (
    scoped
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        "actor_len",
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(w_ticket_id_actor_by_event_at), 3).alias("event_at_cume_dist"),
        F.round(F.avg("actor_len").over(Window.partitionBy("actor_len", "actor")), 2).alias("actor_len_actor_avg_actor_len"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("event_type").over(w_actor_len_ticket_id)).alias("distinct_event_type_in_actor_len_ticket_id"),
        F.round(F.col("actor_len") - F.avg("actor_len").over(Window.partitionBy("actor_len", "actor")), 2).alias("actor_len_vs_actor_len_actor_avg"),
        F.row_number().over(w_event_type_actor_by_event_at).alias("seq_no"),
        F.nth_value("actor_len", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("actor_len", "actor").orderBy(F.col("actor_len").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_actor_len"),
        F.first("event_at", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("actor_len", "event_type").orderBy(F.col("event_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_event_at"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(w_actor_len_event_type_by_even_2), 3).alias("event_at_cume_dist_2"),
        F.round(F.col("actor_len") - F.avg("actor_len").over(Window.partitionBy("actor_len", "ticket_id")), 2).alias("actor_len_vs_actor_len_ticket_id_avg"),
        (F.col("actor_len") - F.lag("actor_len").over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id").orderBy("event_at", "id"))).alias("actor_len_change"),
        F.lag("actor_len").over(w_ticket_id_by_actor_len).alias("prev_actor_len"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("event_type").over(Window.partitionBy("actor_len", "actor"))).alias("distinct_event_type_in_actor_len_actor"),
        F.sum("actor_len").over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", "actor").orderBy(F.col("event_at").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("actor_len_sum_3_prior"),
        F.first("actor_len").over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", "actor").orderBy(F.col("event_at").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_actor_len"),
    )
)

first_rows = (
    windowed
    .filter(F.col("seq_no") == 1)
    .drop("seq_no")
)

w_distinct_event_type_in_actor = Window.partitionBy("distinct_event_type_in_actor_len_actor")
w_distinct_event_type_in_actor_2 = Window.partitionBy("distinct_event_type_in_actor_len_actor", "distinct_event_type_in_actor_len_ticket_id").orderBy("prev_actor_len", "id")
metrics = (
    first_rows
    .select(
        "*",

        F.last("event_at_cume_dist").over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", "first_actor_len").orderBy("actor_len_vs_actor_len_ticket_id_avg", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_event_at_cume_dist"),
        F.max("prev_actor_len").over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", "first_actor_len").orderBy("actor_len_vs_actor_len_ticket_id_avg", "id").rowsBetween(-1, Window.currentRow)).alias("prev_actor_len_max_2"),
        F.sum("first_actor_len").over(w_distinct_event_type_in_actor).alias("distinct_event_type_in_actor_len_actor_sum_first"),
        F.lead("first_known_event_at", 3).over(w_distinct_event_type_in_actor_2).alias("next3_first_known_event_at"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("first_known_event_at"), "actor_len").orderBy(F.col("actor_len_vs_actor_len_actor_avg").desc(), "id")).alias("actor_len_vs_actor_len_actor_avg_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_distinct_event_type_in_actor_2).alias("prev_actor_len_dense_rank"),
    )
)

summary = (
    metrics
    .groupBy("second_actor_len")
    .agg(
        F.sum("actor_len_change").alias("total_actor_len_change"),
        F.round(F.avg("event_at_cume_dist_2"), 2).alias("avg_event_at_cume_dist_2"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("event_type").isin("resolved", "replied"), F.col("distinct_event_type_in_actor_len_actor")).otherwise(0)).alias("distinct_event_type_in_actor_len_actor_event_typ"),
        F.max("actor_len_vs_actor_len_actor_avg_rank").alias("max_actor_len_vs_actor_len_actor_avg_rank"),
        F.max("first_actor_len").alias("max_first_actor_len_check"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("max_first_actor_len_check") > 7)
    .drop("max_first_actor_len_check")
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "second_actor_len",
        "distinct_event_type_in_actor_len_actor_event_typ",
        "max_actor_len_vs_actor_len_actor_avg_rank",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("max_actor_len_vs_actor_len_actor_avg_rank").asc_nulls_last(),
        "distinct_event_type_in_actor_len_actor_event_typ",
    )
)
```

```sql
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(started_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(started_at))) / 60 AS duration_min,
    AVG(island_id) AS avg_island_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN device = 'desktop' THEN 1 END) AS desktop_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN country = 'TH' THEN 1 END) AS th_count
FROM sessions_sessions
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN island_id >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', started_at));
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.orderBy(F.col("event_time").desc(), "id")

    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("event_time") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-03-25")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        F.coalesce("duration_sec", F.lit(0)).alias("duration_sec_filled"),
        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("page_clean"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "page_clean",
        F.avg("duration_sec_filled").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)).alias("duration_sec_filled_avg_5"),
        F.stddev_samp("duration_sec_filled").over(Window.partitionBy("page")).alias("page_stddev_samp_duration_sec_filled"),
        F.row_number().over(w_ordered).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

gaps = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec_filled_avg_5",
        "page_stddev_samp_duration_sec_filled",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("island_id"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    islands
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec_filled_avg_5").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

kept_keys = (
    ranked
    .select("id", "page")
    .subtract(
        df_web_events
        .filter(F.col("event_time") >= "2024-05-10")
        .select("id", "page")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.page") == F.col("k.page")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base_web_events = (
    reconciled
    .filter(~F.col("page").isin(["/search", "/product", "/home"]) & (~F.col("page").eqNullSafe(F.lit("/cart"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec_filled_avg_5",
        "page_stddev_samp_duration_sec_filled",
        "island_id",
        "rn",
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "event_time").alias("event_time_period"),

stats = (

    .groupBy(

        F.when(F.col("island_id") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("island_id_tier"),

        F.size(F.collect_set("page")).alias("num_pages"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("event_time")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("event_time"))) / 60).alias("span_minutes"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("page")).alias("page_list"),
        F.countDistinct("page").alias("distinct_pages"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("distinct_pages") > 1)
)

result = (

    .select(
        "page_stddev_samp_duration_sec_filled_tier",
        "island_id_tier",
        "span_minutes",
        "page_list",
    )

)
```

```sql
    SELECT
```

```sql
        r.site_id,

        r.voltage,
        st.zone,

    LEFT JOIN tariff_windows tw
      ON tw.tariff = st.tariff
     AND r.read_at >= tw.valid_from

),

    FROM combined_details
    GROUP BY site_id
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_voltage,
        ROUND(s.voltage - g.avg_voltage, 2) AS voltage_minus_avg
    FROM combined_details s

    ROUND(STDDEV(voltage), 2) AS stddev_voltage

GROUP BY ROLLUP(site_zone, site_id)
```

```sql
),
ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(rate) OVER (PARTITION BY tariff ORDER BY minutes_valid_to_year_to_valid_to, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_rate,
        ROUND(rate_filled / NULLIF(SUM(rate_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY tariff), 0), 4) AS rate_filled_share_of_tariff
    FROM scored

screened AS (

FROM screened
```

```python
        "s.event_at_plus_2h",
        F.col("t.closed_at").alias("ticket_closed_at"),
    )

        F.ntile(5).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("event_at_plus_2h").desc_nulls_first(), "id")).alias("event_at_plus_2h_quintile"),
```

```sql
        requester_id,
        agent_id,
        opened_at,
        closed_at,
        priority,
        channel
    FROM tickets
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous opened_at per agent_id
    SELECT *, LAG(opened_at) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id ORDER BY opened_at, id) AS prev_opened_at
    FROM prepared

flagged AS (

    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id ORDER BY opened_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        agent_id,
        burst_id,
        MIN(opened_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(opened_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        SUM(requester_id) AS session_requester_id,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(opened_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(opened_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY agent_id, burst_id
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT agent_id, burst_id, field, value
FROM (
    SELECT agent_id, burst_id, session_requester_id, n_events
    FROM session_summary
) src
UNPIVOT (
    value FOR field IN (session_requester_id AS m_session_requester_id, n_events AS n_events_v)
) unp
```

```python
        "opened_at",
        "closed_at",
        "priority",
        "channel",

)

with_prev = prepared.withColumn("prev_opened_at", F.lag("opened_at").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id").orderBy("opened_at", "id")))
```

```sql
WITH base AS (
    -- Scope the enrollments rows
    SELECT
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        term,
        score,
        enrolled_at
    FROM enrollments
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous enrolled_at per course_id
    SELECT *, LAG(enrolled_at) OVER (PARTITION BY course_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id) AS prev_enrolled_at
    FROM base
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_enrolled_at IS NULL OR enrolled_at > prev_enrolled_at + INTERVAL 60 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY course_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        course_id,
        burst_id,
        MIN(enrolled_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(enrolled_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(enrolled_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(enrolled_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY course_id, burst_id
),
per_group AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        course_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_start) AS session_start_month,
        ROUND(SUM(burst_id) / NULLIF(SUM(n_events), 0), 3) AS burst_id_to_n_events_ratio,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(duration_min, 0.5) AS median_duration_min,
        MAX(session_start) AS last_session_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) AS distinct_course_ids,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(n_events, 0.5) AS median_n_events
    FROM per_session
    GROUP BY course_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_start)
    HAVING SUM(n_events) > 3
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    course_id,
    session_start_month,
    burst_id_to_n_events_ratio,
    median_duration_min,
    last_session_start,
    distinct_course_ids,
    median_n_events,
    DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', last_session_start) AS days_since_last_session_start
FROM per_group
ORDER BY median_n_events DESC NULLS FIRST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_enrollments
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "enrolled_at",
    )
)

with_prev = base.withColumn("prev_enrolled_at", F.lag("enrolled_at").over(Window.partitionBy("course_id").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_enrolled_at").isNull() | (F.col("enrolled_at") > F.col("prev_enrolled_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("course_id").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("course_id", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("enrolled_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("enrolled_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_events"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("enrolled_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("enrolled_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

per_group = (
    per_session
    .groupBy(
        "course_id",
        F.date_trunc("month", "session_start").alias("session_start_month"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("burst_id") / F.nullif(F.sum("n_events"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("burst_id_to_n_events_ratio"),
        F.percentile_approx("duration_min", 0.5).alias("median_duration_min"),
        F.max("session_start").alias("last_session_start"),
        F.countDistinct("course_id").alias("distinct_course_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("n_events", 0.5).alias("median_n_events"),
        F.sum("n_events").alias("sum_n_events_check"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("sum_n_events_check") > 3)
    .drop("sum_n_events_check")
)

result = (
    per_group
    .select(
        "course_id",
        "session_start_month",
        "burst_id_to_n_events_ratio",
        "median_duration_min",
        "last_session_start",
        "distinct_course_ids",
        "median_n_events",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("last_session_start")).alias("days_since_last_session_start"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("median_n_events").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

```sql
        priority,

        event_at,
        event_type,
        MAX(requester_id) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, agent_id ORDER BY event_at, id, event_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS requester_id_max_3,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel, agent_id ORDER BY event_at, id, event_id) AS event_at_dense_rank
    FROM line_level

priority_stats AS (

    FROM sequenced
    GROUP BY priority
```

```sql
car_by_track AS (

    FROM plays
    WHERE device = 'car'
    GROUP BY track_id
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.track_id, b.track_id) AS track_id,
    COALESCE(a.phone_count, 0) AS phone_count,
    a.phone_total_ms_played,
    COALESCE(b.car_count, 0) AS car_count,
    COALESCE(b.car_total_ms_played, 0) AS car_total_ms_played,
    COALESCE(a.phone_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.car_count, 0) AS phone_count_minus_car_count
FROM phone_by_track a
FULL OUTER JOIN car_by_track b
  ON a.track_id = b.track_id
ORDER BY track_id
```

```sql
    claimed_amount,
    prev_approved_amount,
```

```sql
WITH in_window AS (
    -- Price each reading with the tariff window it falls into
    SELECT
        r.id,
        r.site_id,
        r.read_at,
        r.kwh,
        r.voltage,
        st.zone,
        tw.rate,
        ROUND(r.kwh * tw.rate, 2) AS energy_cost
    FROM meter_readings r
    JOIN sites st ON st.id = r.site_id
    JOIN tariff_windows tw
      ON tw.tariff = st.tariff
     AND r.read_at >= tw.valid_from
     AND r.read_at < tw.valid_to
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(energy_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(read_at) ORDER BY rate DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_energy_cost,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(zone) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id, MONTH(read_at))) AS distinct_zone_in_site_id_read_at_month,
        NTILE(5) OVER w_read_at_month_site_id_by_kwh AS kwh_quintile,
        ROUND(rate - AVG(rate) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id, MONTH(read_at)), 2) AS rate_vs_site_id_read_at_month_avg,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at), site_id ORDER BY kwh, id), 3) AS kwh_cume_dist
    FROM in_window
    WINDOW w_read_at_month_site_id_by_kwh AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at), site_id ORDER BY kwh, id)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per zone, site_id
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        voltage,
        zone,
        rate,
        energy_cost,
        first_energy_cost,
        distinct_zone_in_site_id_read_at_month,
        kwh_quintile,
        rate_vs_site_id_read_at_month_avg,
        kwh_cume_dist
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY zone, site_id ORDER BY read_at DESC, id DESC) AS rn
        FROM with_trends
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach meter_readings metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MAX(m.read_at) FROM meter_readings m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS last_reading_read_at
    FROM deduped s
)
SELECT
    distinct_zone_in_site_id_read_at_month,
    kwh_quintile,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE zone = 'Z3') AS n_zone_z3,
    ROUND(SUM(energy_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(kwh), 0), 3) AS energy_cost_to_kwh_ratio
FROM with_stats
GROUP BY CUBE(distinct_zone_in_site_id_read_at_month, kwh_quintile)
ORDER BY distinct_zone_in_site_id_read_at_month NULLS LAST, kwh_quintile NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

in_window = (
    df_meter_readings.alias("r")
    .join(df_sites.alias("st"), F.col("st.id") == F.col("r.site_id"), "inner")
    .join(
        df_tariff_windows.alias("tw"),
        (F.col("tw.tariff") == F.col("st.tariff"))
        & (F.col("r.read_at") >= F.col("tw.valid_from"))
        & (F.col("r.read_at") < F.col("tw.valid_to")),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        "r.id",
        "r.site_id",
        "r.read_at",
        "r.kwh",
        "r.voltage",
        "st.zone",
        "tw.rate",
        F.round(F.col("r.kwh") * F.col("tw.rate"), 2).alias("energy_cost"),
    )
)

w_read_at_month_site_id_by_kwh = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "read_at"), "site_id").orderBy("kwh", "id")
with_trends = (
    in_window
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("energy_cost").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("read_at")).orderBy(F.col("rate").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_energy_cost"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("zone").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", F.month("read_at")))).alias("distinct_zone_in_site_id_read_at_month"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w_read_at_month_site_id_by_kwh).alias("kwh_quintile"),
        F.round(F.col("rate") - F.avg("rate").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", F.month("read_at"))), 2).alias("rate_vs_site_id_read_at_month_avg"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "read_at"), "site_id").orderBy("kwh", "id")), 3).alias("kwh_cume_dist"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    with_trends
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("zone", "site_id").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), F.col("id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

reading_stats = (
    df_meter_readings
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(F.max("read_at").alias("last_reading_read_at"))
)

with_stats = (
    deduped.alias("s")
    .join(reading_stats.alias("m"), F.col("m.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", "m.last_reading_read_at")
)

result = (
    with_stats
    .cube("distinct_zone_in_site_id_read_at_month", "kwh_quintile")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("zone") == "Z3", 1)).alias("n_zone_z3"),
        F.round(F.sum("energy_cost") / F.nullif(F.sum("kwh"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("energy_cost_to_kwh_ratio"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("distinct_zone_in_site_id_read_at_month").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("kwh_quintile").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)
```

```sql
    GROUP BY site_id

ok_by_site AS (

    FROM meter_readings

    GROUP BY site_id
)
SELECT

    COALESCE(a.bad_count, 0) AS bad_count,
    COALESCE(a.bad_total_kwh, 0) AS bad_total_kwh,
    COALESCE(b.ok_count, 0) AS ok_count,
    COALESCE(b.ok_total_kwh, 0) AS ok_total_kwh,
    COALESCE(a.bad_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.ok_count, 0) AS bad_count_minus_ok_count
FROM bad_by_site a
FULL OUTER JOIN ok_by_site b
  ON a.site_id = b.site_id
ORDER BY site_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

bad_by_site = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("quality") == "BAD")
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("bad_count"), F.sum("kwh").alias("bad_total_kwh"))
)

ok_by_site = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("quality") == "OK")
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("ok_count"), F.sum("kwh").alias("ok_total_kwh"))
)

result = (
    bad_by_site.alias("a")
    .join(ok_by_site.alias("b"), F.col("a.site_id") == F.col("b.site_id"), "full")
    .select(

        F.coalesce(F.col("a.bad_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("bad_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.bad_total_kwh"), F.lit(0)).alias("bad_total_kwh"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.ok_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("ok_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.ok_total_kwh"), F.lit(0)).alias("ok_total_kwh"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.bad_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.ok_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("bad_count_minus_ok_count"),
```

```sql
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR txn_time > LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time, id) + INTERVAL 30 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM transactions
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM with_gaps
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        session_start_flag,
        session_no,
        CEIL(session_no) AS session_no_whole
    FROM islands
    WHERE session_no BETWEEN 2 AND 3
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY session_start_flag, id) AS dedup_rank
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT txn_type
    FROM deduped
    INTERSECT
    SELECT txn_type
    FROM transactions
    WHERE is_flagged
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.txn_type = k.txn_type
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        session_start_flag,
        session_no,
        session_no_whole,
        dedup_rank,
        session_no + session_start_flag AS session_no_plus_session_start_flag
    FROM verified

),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach accounts attributes

),
enriched_transactions AS (

daily AS (

)
```

```sql
    FROM sessionized

)
```

```sql
    greatest_reading_count_site_installed_kw,

FROM enriched
WHERE reading_count >= 2
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("kwh") >= 14.5)
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
    )
)

with_parent_site = (
    valid.alias("s")
    .join(df_sites.alias("si"), F.col("si.id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("si.tariff").alias("site_tariff"), "si.site_name")
)

joined_site = (
    with_parent_site.alias("s")
    .join(df_sites.alias("si"), F.col("si.id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("si.installed_kw") < 373.3)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.site_id",
        "s.read_at",
        "s.kwh",
        "s.voltage",
        "s.quality",
        "s.site_tariff",
        "s.site_name",
        F.col("si.installed_kw").alias("site_installed_kw"),
        F.col("si.tariff").alias("site_tariff_2"),
    )
)

reading_stats = (
    df_meter_readings
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum("kwh").alias("total_reading_kwh"),
        F.count("*").alias("reading_count"),
    )
)

profiled = (
    joined_site.alias("s")
    .join(reading_stats.alias("m"), F.col("m.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "m.total_reading_kwh",
        F.coalesce(F.col("m.reading_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("reading_count"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    profiled
    .select(
        "*",
        F.greatest(F.col("reading_count"), F.col("site_installed_kw")).alias("greatest_reading_count_site_installed_kw"),
        F.when(F.col("site_tariff").isin("FLAT", "EV"), "group_a").when(F.col("site_tariff") == "TOU", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("site_tariff_group"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("reading_count") >= 2)
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        "site_tariff",
        "site_name",
        "site_installed_kw",
        "site_tariff_2",
        "total_reading_kwh",
        "greatest_reading_count_site_installed_kw",
        "site_tariff_group",
        F.coalesce(F.col("kwh"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("kwh_filled"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("voltage").desc_nulls_first(), "site_id")
)
```

```sql
        t.agent_id,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(e.event_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(t.opened_at)) / 3600, 2) AS hours_since_open
    FROM ticket_events e
    JOIN tickets t
      ON t.id = e.ticket_id
     AND e.event_at >= t.opened_at
     AND e.event_at <= COALESCE(t.closed_at, t.opened_at + INTERVAL 3 DAYS)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep the earliest row per ticket_id, agent_id
    SELECT
        id,
        ticket_id,
        event_at,
        event_type,
        priority,
        agent_id,
        hours_since_open
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_id, agent_id ORDER BY hours_since_open, id) AS recency_rank
        FROM covered
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS

    agent_id,

    MIN(hours_since_open) AS min_hours_since_open,
    SUM(hours_since_open) FILTER (WHERE priority IN ('P4', 'P1', 'P2')) AS hours_since_open_priority_in_p4_p1_p2,
    ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN event_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_event_type_is_not_null
FROM deduped
```

```python
filtered = (
    df_sessions
    .filter((F.col("started_at") > F.lit("2023-08-21 02:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (F.col("country") == "UK"))

    .groupingSets([["device", "browser"], ["device"], []], "device", "browser")
```

```sql
    FROM store_sales

),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)

    FROM deduped
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (ORDER BY revenue ASC NULLS FIRST)
),
deduped_store_sales AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM scored
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY store_id_avg_revenue DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC) = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    product_id,
    sale_date,
    revenue,
    revenue_adjusted,
    rn
FROM deduped_store_sales;
```

```python
recent_plays = (
    df_plays

    .select(

        "listener_id",
        "track_id",
        "ms_played",
        "device",
        "is_skipped",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-06-30").cast("date"), F.col("played_at")).alias("days_since_played_at"),
    )
)

w_all_by_days_since_played_at = Window.orderBy("days_since_played_at", "id")
w_listener_id_device = Window.partitionBy("listener_id", "device")
ranked = (

        "*",
```

```sql
        UPPER(TRIM(country)) AS country_clean,
        CONCAT(genre, '#', CAST(debut_year AS STRING)) AS genre_ref
    FROM artists
    WHERE is_verified = TRUE
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach tracks metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MAX(t.release_date) FROM tracks t WHERE t.artist_id = s.id) AS last_track_release_date,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks t WHERE t.artist_id = s.id) AS track_count
    FROM prepared_artists s
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        artist_name,
        genre,
        country,
        is_verified,
        genre_or_unknown,
        country_clean,
        genre_ref,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY genre_or_unknown, country ORDER BY track_count ASC, id) AS track_count_quintile,
        DATEDIFF(last_track_release_date, LAG(last_track_release_date) OVER w_last_track_release_date_year) AS days_since_prev_last_track_release_date,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(country) OVER (PARTITION BY is_verified)) AS distinct_country_in_is_verified,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(last_track_release_date) ORDER BY track_count), 3) AS track_count_cume_dist,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(genre) OVER w_is_verified) AS distinct_genre_in_is_verified
    FROM with_stats

),
genre_stats AS (
    -- Avg days_since_prev_last_track_release_date per genre
    SELECT genre, AVG(days_since_prev_last_track_release_date) AS avg_days_since_prev_last_track_release_date
    FROM with_windows
    GROUP BY genre
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_days_since_prev_last_track_release_date,
        ROUND(s.days_since_prev_last_track_release_date - g.avg_days_since_prev_last_track_release_date, 2) AS days_since_prev_last_track_release_date_minus_av
    FROM with_windows s
    JOIN genre_stats g ON g.genre = s.genre
    WHERE s.days_since_prev_last_track_release_date > g.avg_days_since_prev_last_track_release_date
)

    SELECT track_count_quintile, genre_or_unknown, distinct_genre_in_is_verified
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared_artists = (
    df_artists
    .filter(F.col("is_verified"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "artist_name",
        "genre",
        "country",
        "is_verified",
        F.coalesce(F.col("genre"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("genre_or_unknown"),
        F.upper(F.trim(F.col("country"))).alias("country_clean"),
        F.concat(F.col("genre"), F.lit("#"), F.col("debut_year").cast("string")).alias("genre_ref"),
    )
)

track_stats = (
    df_tracks
    .groupBy("artist_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("release_date").alias("last_track_release_date"),
        F.count("*").alias("track_count"),
    )
)

with_stats = (
    prepared_artists.alias("s")
    .join(track_stats.alias("t"), F.col("t.artist_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "t.last_track_release_date",
        F.coalesce(F.col("t.track_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("track_count"),
    )
)

w_last_track_release_date_year = Window.partitionBy(F.year("last_track_release_date")).orderBy("track_count", "id")
w_is_verified = Window.partitionBy("is_verified")
with_windows = (
    with_stats
    .select(
        "id",
        "artist_name",
        "genre",
        "country",
        "is_verified",
        "genre_or_unknown",
        "country_clean",
        "genre_ref",
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("genre_or_unknown", "country").orderBy("track_count", "id")).alias("track_count_quintile"),
        F.datediff(F.col("last_track_release_date"), F.lag("last_track_release_date").over(w_last_track_release_date_year)).alias("days_since_prev_last_track_release_date"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("country").over(Window.partitionBy("is_verified"))).alias("distinct_country_in_is_verified"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("last_track_release_date")).orderBy("track_count")), 3).alias("track_count_cume_dist"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("genre").over(w_is_verified)).alias("distinct_genre_in_is_verified"),
    )
)

genre_stats = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy("genre")
    .agg(F.avg("days_since_prev_last_track_release_date").alias("avg_days_since_prev_last_track_release_date"))
)

outliers = (
    with_windows.alias("s")
    .join(genre_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.genre") == F.col("s.genre"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.days_since_prev_last_track_release_date") > F.col("g.avg_days_since_prev_last_track_release_date"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_days_since_prev_last_track_release_date",
        F.round(F.col("s.days_since_prev_last_track_release_date") - F.col("g.avg_days_since_prev_last_track_release_date"), 2).alias("days_since_prev_last_track_release_date_minus_av"),
    )
)

result = (
    outliers
    .groupBy("track_count_quintile")
    .pivot("genre_or_unknown", ["Indie", "Classical"])
    .agg(F.sum("distinct_genre_in_is_verified"))
    .orderBy("track_count_quintile")
)
```

```sql
        a.site_id,

     AND b.read_at < a.read_at
     AND b.read_at >= a.read_at - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.site_id, a.read_at
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        prior_kwh_7d,
        TO_DATE(read_at) AS read_at_date
    FROM matched
    WHERE read_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-08 10:00:00'
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach meter_readings metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MAX(m.voltage) FROM meter_readings m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS max_reading_voltage,
        (SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN m.quality = 'BAD' THEN 1 END) FROM meter_readings m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS reading_quality_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meter_readings m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS reading_count
    FROM annotated s

        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY prior_kwh_7d DESC), 3) AS prior_kwh_7d_percent_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(read_at_date) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY prior_kwh_7d DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_read_at_date,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY reading_count, site_id) AS rows_in_reading_count_site_id,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_all_by_prior_kwh_7d_ties, 3) AS prior_kwh_7d_cume_dist,
        LAST_VALUE(read_at) OVER (ORDER BY prior_kwh_7d DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_read_at
    FROM profiled
```

```python
        & (F.col("b.read_at") >= F.col("a.read_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.site_id", "a.read_at")
```

```sql
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter tickets
    SELECT
        id,
        requester_id,
        agent_id,
        closed_at,
        priority,
        channel,
        csat,
        tags
    FROM tickets
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous closed_at per channel
    SELECT *, LAG(closed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY closed_at, id) AS prev_closed_at
    FROM filtered
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_closed_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(closed_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_closed_at)) / 60 > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY closed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach tickets metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(t.requester_id) FROM tickets t WHERE t.agent_id = s.agent_id) AS min_ticket_requester_id
    FROM sessionized s
),
derived AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        requester_id,
        closed_at,
        csat,
        tags,
        session_id,
        min_ticket_requester_id,
        CASE WHEN priority IN ('P4', 'P2') THEN 'group_a' WHEN priority = 'P3' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS priority_group,
        QUARTER(prev_closed_at) AS prev_closed_at_quarter,
        CASE WHEN channel IN ('email', 'phone') THEN 'group_a' WHEN channel = 'web' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS channel_group
    FROM summarized_rows
)
SELECT
    prev_closed_at_quarter,
    priority_group,
    session_id,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid,
    ROUND(SUM(prev_closed_at_quarter) / NULLIF(SUM(csat), 0), 3) AS prev_closed_at_quarter_to_csat_ratio,
    COUNT(DISTINCT priority_group) AS distinct_priority_groups,
    SUM(requester_id) AS total_requester_id
FROM derived
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((prev_closed_at_quarter, priority_group, session_id), (prev_closed_at_quarter))
ORDER BY prev_closed_at_quarter NULLS LAST, priority_group NULLS LAST, session_id NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_tickets
    .select(
        "id",
        "requester_id",
        "agent_id",
        "closed_at",
        "priority",
        "channel",
        "csat",
        "tags",
    )
)

with_prev = filtered.withColumn("prev_closed_at", F.lag("closed_at").over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("closed_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_closed_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("closed_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_closed_at")) / 60 > 60), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("closed_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

ticket_stats = (
    df_tickets
    .groupBy("agent_id")
    .agg(F.min("requester_id").alias("min_ticket_requester_id"))
)

summarized_rows = (
    sessionized.alias("s")
    .join(ticket_stats.alias("t"), F.col("t.agent_id") == F.col("s.agent_id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", "t.min_ticket_requester_id")
)

derived = (
    summarized_rows
    .select(
        "id",
        "requester_id",
        "closed_at",
        "csat",
        "tags",
        "session_id",
        "min_ticket_requester_id",
        F.when(F.col("priority").isin("P4", "P2"), "group_a").when(F.col("priority") == "P3", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("priority_group"),
        F.quarter(F.col("prev_closed_at")).alias("prev_closed_at_quarter"),
        F.when(F.col("channel").isin("email", "phone"), "group_a").when(F.col("channel") == "web", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("channel_group"),
    )
)

result = (
    derived
    .groupingSets(
        [["prev_closed_at_quarter", "priority_group", "session_id"], ["prev_closed_at_quarter"]],
        "prev_closed_at_quarter", "priority_group", "session_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
        F.round(F.sum("prev_closed_at_quarter") / F.nullif(F.sum("csat"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("prev_closed_at_quarter_to_csat_ratio"),
        F.countDistinct("priority_group").alias("distinct_priority_groups"),
        F.sum("requester_id").alias("total_requester_id"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("prev_closed_at_quarter").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("priority_group").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("session_id").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)
```

```python
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_shipped_date_period").isNull() | (F.col("shipped_date_period") > F.col("prev_shipped_date_period") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)
```

```sql
    FROM with_activity s
    LEFT JOIN move_stats st ON st.sku_id = s.id
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(last_moved_at) AS last_moved_at_day,
        YEAR(first_moved_at) AS first_moved_at_year,

        MIN(move_move_type_count) AS min_move_move_type_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE category IN ('Beauty', 'Apparel', 'Toys')) AS n_category_in_beauty_apparel_t

    min_move_move_type_count - first_moved_at_year AS min_move_move_type_count_minus_first_moved_at_ye,
```

```python
        "unit_price",

)
```

```python
    filtered_tracks
    .groupBy(

w_distinct_ids_bpm_tier_by_dis = Window.partitionBy("distinct_ids", "bpm_tier").orderBy("distinct_ids", "bpm_tier")
with_trends_2 = (
```

```sql
        s.first_known_end_date,
        p.region AS holder_region
    FROM metrics s
    JOIN policyholders p ON p.id = s.holder_id

combined_details AS (

    FROM combined_details
    GROUP BY status

vs_group AS (
```

```sql
    FROM flagged
```

```sql
        SUM(csat) AS session_csat,
```

```sql
    SELECT *
    FROM claims
```

```sql
qualified AS (
    -- Compare against the overall min
    SELECT *
    FROM stats
    WHERE row_count > (SELECT MIN(row_count) FROM stats)
),
labeled AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        claim_type,
        stddev_claimed_amount,
        row_count,
        distinct_status,
        COALESCE(distinct_status, 0) AS distinct_status_filled
    FROM qualified
)
SELECT claim_type, field, value
FROM (
    SELECT claim_type, distinct_status, distinct_status_filled
    FROM labeled
) src
UNPIVOT (
    value FOR field IN (distinct_status, distinct_status_filled)
```

```python
    df_claims
    .filter((F.col("adjuster_id").isNotNull()) & (F.col("status").isin("IN_REVIEW", "APPROVED", "OPEN")))
)

    valid
    .filter(F.col("policy_id") >= 12)
    .groupBy("claim_type")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev("claimed_amount"), 2).alias("stddev_claimed_amount"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.countDistinct("status").alias("distinct_status"),
    )

        "row_count",

    )
)

result = (
```

```sql
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(played_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(played_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY source, session_no
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    source,
    session_no,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    events,
    duration_min
FROM per_session
ORDER BY session_end
```

```sql
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        policy_id,
        adjuster_id,
        claim_date,
        claimed_amount,
        approved_amount,
        status,
        DATE_FORMAT(reported_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:00') AS reported_at_label,
        CASE WHEN claimed_amount >= 34763.4 THEN 'A' WHEN claimed_amount >= 10518.4 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS claimed_amount_tier
    FROM claims
    WHERE claim_type IS NOT NULL
      AND reported_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-08 14:00:00'
),
with_parent_policy AS (
    -- Join policies
    SELECT
        s.*,
        p.premium AS policy_premium,
        po.holder_name,
        po.region AS holder_region
    FROM valid s
    LEFT JOIN policies p ON p.id = s.policy_id
    LEFT JOIN policyholders po ON po.id = p.holder_id
),
scored AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        policy_id,
        claim_date,
        approved_amount,
        reported_at_label,
        claimed_amount_tier,
        holder_name,
        holder_region,
        policy_premium - approved_amount AS policy_premium_minus_approved_amount,
        CONCAT(holder_name, '#', CAST(adjuster_id AS STRING)) AS holder_name_ref,
        COALESCE(approved_amount, 0.0) AS approved_amount_filled
    FROM with_parent_policy
),
windowed AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(AVG(approved_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY policy_id, YEAR(claim_date) ORDER BY approved_amount ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS approved_amount_avg_2_prior,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY policy_id, YEAR(claim_date) ORDER BY approved_amount ASC, id) AS approved_amount_rank
    FROM scored
),
exploded_detail_claims AS (
    -- One row per claim
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.policy_id,
        s.claim_date,
        s.reported_at_label,
        s.claimed_amount_tier,
        s.holder_name,
        s.policy_premium_minus_approved_amount,
        s.holder_name_ref,
        s.approved_amount_filled,
        s.approved_amount_avg_2_prior,
        c.id AS claim_id,
        c.status AS claim_status,
        c.claimed_amount AS claim_claimed_amount,
        c.adjuster_id AS claim_adjuster_id,
        c.claim_date AS claim_claim_date
    FROM windowed s
    JOIN claims c ON c.policy_id = s.policy_id
)
SELECT id, claim_id, field, metric_value
FROM (
    SELECT id, claim_id, approved_amount_filled, policy_premium_minus_approved_amount, claim_claimed_amount
    FROM exploded_detail_claims
) src
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR field IN (approved_amount_filled, policy_premium_minus_approved_amount, claim_claimed_amount)
) unp
```

```sql
    SELECT
```

```sql
        warehouse_id,
        sku_id,
```

```sql
        operator,
        unit_price
    FROM stock_moves
    WHERE operator = 'op_bee'
),
enriched AS (

        w.opened_on AS warehouse_opened_on,

    FROM scoped_moves s
    JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id
    LEFT JOIN skus sk ON sk.id = s.sku_id
),
operator_stats AS (
    -- Avg unit_price per operator
    SELECT operator, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_unit_price
    FROM enriched
    GROUP BY operator
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_unit_price,
        ROUND(s.unit_price - g.avg_unit_price, 2) AS unit_price_minus_avg
    FROM enriched s
    JOIN operator_stats g ON g.operator = s.operator
    WHERE s.unit_price > g.avg_unit_price
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT warehouse_id, operator, avg_unit_price
    FROM outliers
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(avg_unit_price)
    FOR operator IN ('op_eve', 'op_chan', 'op_dew', 'op_bee')
)
ORDER BY warehouse_id
```

```python
        F.col("w.city").alias("warehouse_city"),
        F.col("sk.category").alias("sku_category"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("session_no")

with_windows = (
    df_web_events
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("last7_count_duration_sec"),
        F.avg("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("last7_avg_duration_sec"),
        F.sum("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("last7_sum_duration_sec"),
    )
)

with_prev = with_windows.withColumn("prev_event_time", F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_event_time").isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.col("prev_event_time") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

metrics = (
    islands
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "duration_sec",
        "last7_count_duration_sec",
        "last7_avg_duration_sec",
        "last7_sum_duration_sec",
        F.rank().over(w_grp).alias("session_no_rank"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("page", "session_id").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc(), "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("prev_event_time").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("prev_event_time", "id")).alias("seq_no_2"),
        F.lag("last7_sum_duration_sec", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("last7_sum_duration_sec", "id")).alias("prev_last7_sum_duration_sec"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    metrics
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("p"), F.col("a.session_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("p.device") == "tablet")

    .alias("a")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("s"), F.col("a.session_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .select("a.*", F.col("s.device"))

daily = (
    joined
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("row_seq") >= 8, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("row_seq_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 500, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("duration_sec_tier"),

        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),

    .withColumn("avg_last7_avg_duration_sec_rank", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("row_seq_tier").orderBy(F.col("avg_last7_avg_duration_sec").desc())))
```

```sql
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id_2
    FROM with_gaps
)

    CASE WHEN session_id_2 >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS session_id_2_tier,
    event_type,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(page)) AS num_pages,

FROM sessions_web_events
```

```sql
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id) IS NULL

    FROM gaps

        MAX(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY session_no, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last7_max_amount,

    FROM islands
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("is_new_burst").desc(), "id")

latest = (
    df_payments
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("method", "status").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

gaps = (
    latest
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

metrics = (
    islands
    .withColumn("last7_sum_amount", F.sum("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy("session_no", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("last7_max_amount", F.max("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy("session_no", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("last7_avg_amount", F.avg("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy("session_no", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)))
)

with_windows = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last("last7_sum_amount", ignorenulls=True).over(w_part).alias("last_known_last7_sum_amount"),
        F.sum("last7_avg_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id")).alias("order_id_sum_last7_avg_amount"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w_recent).alias("is_new_burst_bucket"),
    )
)

with_prev = with_windows.withColumn("prev_paid_at", F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_paid_at").isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.col("prev_paid_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands_payments = (
    flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        "is_new_burst",
        "last7_sum_amount",
        "last_known_last7_sum_amount",
        "order_id_sum_last7_avg_amount",

    islands_payments

)

reconciled = (
    islands_payments
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")

totals = (

    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("last7_sum_amount") >= 9000, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("last7_sum_amount_tier"),

result = (

        "started_at",
```

```sql
),
```
```sql
verified AS (
```

```sql
    SELECT s.*
    FROM joined s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.channel = k.channel AND s.status = k.status
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid_skus = (
    df_skus
    .filter(F.col("category").isin("Food", "Electronics"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "sku_code",
        "category",
        "unit_cost",
        "weight_kg",
        "is_active",
    )
)

w_is_active_by_weight_kg_ties = Window.partitionBy("is_active").orderBy(F.col("weight_kg").desc())
w_all_by_unit_cost = Window.orderBy("unit_cost", "id")
w_is_active = Window.partitionBy("is_active")
sequenced = (
    valid_skus
    .select(
        "id",
        "category",
        "unit_cost",
        "weight_kg",
        "is_active",
        F.last("weight_kg").over(Window.orderBy("unit_cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_weight_kg"),
        F.first("weight_kg", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("weight_kg", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_weight_kg"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_is_active_by_weight_kg_ties).alias("weight_kg_dense_rank"),
        F.lag("unit_cost").over(Window.partitionBy("is_active", "category").orderBy("unit_cost", "id")).alias("prev_unit_cost"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("is_active")).alias("rows_in_is_active"),
        F.rank().over(w_all_by_unit_cost).alias("unit_cost_rank"),
        F.round(F.col("weight_kg") - F.avg("weight_kg").over(Window.partitionBy("is_active")), 2).alias("weight_kg_vs_is_active_avg"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("weight_kg", "id")), 3).alias("weight_kg_cume_dist"),
        F.first("weight_kg", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("is_active", "category").orderBy("unit_cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_weight_kg_2"),
        F.min("unit_cost").over(Window.orderBy("unit_cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("min_unit_cost_so_far"),
        F.max("unit_cost").over(Window.partitionBy("is_active")).alias("is_active_max_unit_cost"),
        F.lead("unit_cost", 3).over(Window.partitionBy("is_active", "category").orderBy("unit_cost", "id")).alias("next3_unit_cost"),
        F.round(F.col("unit_cost") / F.nullif(F.sum("unit_cost").over(w_is_active), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("unit_cost_share_of_is_active"),

    )
)

    sequenced
    .filter(F.col("weight_kg_dense_rank") <= 5)
    .drop("weight_kg_dense_rank")

        "first_known_weight_kg_2",

        "next3_unit_cost",
        "unit_cost_share_of_is_active",
        "unit_cost_cume_dist",
    )
    .orderBy(
```

```sql
),
with_prev AS (

    SELECT *, LAG(read_at) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY read_at, id) AS prev_read_at
    FROM recent
),
flagged AS (

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_read_at IS NULL OR read_at > prev_read_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY read_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        site_id,
        session_no,
        MIN(read_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(read_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(read_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(read_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY site_id, session_no
),
with_counts AS (
    -- Attach meter_readings metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT SUM(m.kwh) FROM meter_readings m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS total_reading_kwh,
        (SELECT MAX(m.read_at) FROM meter_readings m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS last_reading_read_at,
        (SELECT MAX(m.read_at) FROM meter_readings m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS last_reading_read_at_2
    FROM per_session s
)
-- Final projection
```
