```sql
WITH cleaned_enrollments AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        term,
        score,
        grade_status,
        enrolled_at,
        CASE WHEN grade_status IN ('WITHDRAWN', 'INCOMPLETE') THEN 'group_a' WHEN grade_status = 'PASS' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS grade_status_group
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE course_id <= 6
      AND grade_status NOT IN ('FAIL', 'WITHDRAWN')
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_course_id_grade_status_group AS rows_in_course_id_grade_status_group,
        LAG(enrolled_at, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY score ASC, id) AS prev2_enrolled_at,
        SUM(score) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY score ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_score
    FROM cleaned_enrollments
    WINDOW w_course_id_grade_status_group AS (PARTITION BY course_id, grade_status_group)
),
term_stats AS (
    -- Avg running_score per term
    SELECT term, AVG(running_score) AS avg_running_score
    FROM with_trends
    GROUP BY term
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_running_score,
        ROUND(s.running_score - g.avg_running_score, 2) AS running_score_minus_avg
    FROM with_trends s
    JOIN term_stats g ON g.term = s.term
    WHERE s.running_score > g.avg_running_score
),
screened AS (
    -- Rows that have matching enrollments
    SELECT s.*
    FROM outliers s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM enrollments e
            WHERE e.course_id = s.course_id
        )
      AND s.term <> '2025T1'
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    course_id,
    COALESCE(grade_status_group, 'ALL') AS grade_status_group,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid,
    MAX(running_score_minus_avg) AS max_running_score_minus_avg
FROM screened
GROUP BY CUBE(course_id, grade_status_group)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned_enrollments = (
    df_enrollments
    .filter((F.col("course_id") <= 6) & (~F.col("grade_status").isin("FAIL", "WITHDRAWN")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",
        F.when(F.col("grade_status").isin("WITHDRAWN", "INCOMPLETE"), "group_a").when(F.col("grade_status") == "PASS", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("grade_status_group"),
    )
)

w_course_id_grade_status_group = Window.partitionBy("course_id", "grade_status_group")
with_trends = (
    cleaned_enrollments
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_course_id_grade_status_group).alias("rows_in_course_id_grade_status_group"),
        F.lag("enrolled_at", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("student_id").orderBy("score", "id")).alias("prev2_enrolled_at"),
        F.sum("score").over(Window.partitionBy("student_id").orderBy("score", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_score"),
    )
)

term_stats = (
    with_trends
    .groupBy("term")
    .agg(F.avg("running_score").alias("avg_running_score"))
)

outliers = (
    with_trends.alias("s")
    .join(term_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.term") == F.col("s.term"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.running_score") > F.col("g.avg_running_score"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_running_score",
        F.round(F.col("s.running_score") - F.col("g.avg_running_score"), 2).alias("running_score_minus_avg"),
    )
)

screened = (
    outliers.alias("s")
    .join(df_enrollments.alias("e"), F.col("e.course_id") == F.col("s.course_id"), "left_semi")
    .filter(F.col("term") != "2025T1")
)

result = (
    screened
    .cube("course_id", "grade_status_group")
    .agg(
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
        F.max("running_score_minus_avg").alias("max_running_score_minus_avg"),
    )
    .select(
        "course_id",
        F.coalesce(F.col("grade_status_group"), F.lit("ALL")).alias("grade_status_group"),
        "gid",
        "max_running_score_minus_avg",
    )
)
```

```sql
        artist_id,
        title,
        release_date,
        moods
    FROM tracks

with_details AS (
    -- Join artists

    FROM base s
    JOIN artists a ON a.id = s.artist_id
    WHERE a.debut_year >= 1996
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(AVG(artist_debut_year) OVER w_artist_id, 2) AS artist_id_avg_artist_debut_year,
        MIN(artist_debut_year) OVER (PARTITION BY artist_id) AS artist_id_min_artist_debut_year,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_artist_id_by_artist_debut_ye, 3) AS artist_debut_year_cume_dist,
        LEAD(release_date, 2) OVER w_all_by_artist_debut_year AS next2_release_date,
        ROUND(artist_debut_year / NULLIF(SUM(artist_debut_year) OVER (PARTITION BY artist_id), 0), 4) AS artist_debut_year_share_of_artist_id,
        LAG(release_date, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(release_date) ORDER BY release_date, id) AS prev3_release_date,
        MIN(artist_debut_year) OVER (PARTITION BY artist_id ORDER BY artist_debut_year, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS min_artist_debut_year_so_far,
        SUM(artist_debut_year) OVER (PARTITION BY artist_id ORDER BY artist_debut_year ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_artist_debut_year,
        ROUND(artist_debut_year - AVG(artist_debut_year) OVER w_artist_id, 2) AS artist_debut_year_vs_artist_id_avg,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_release_date_year_by_release, 3) AS release_date_percent_rank
    FROM with_details
    WINDOW w_artist_id AS (PARTITION BY artist_id), w_artist_id_by_artist_debut_ye AS (PARTITION BY artist_id ORDER BY artist_debut_year ASC), w_all_by_artist_debut_year AS (ORDER BY artist_debut_year NULLS LAST, id), w_release_date_year_by_release AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(release_date) ORDER BY release_date, id)
),
summary AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics

        YEAR(next2_release_date) AS next2_release_date_year,

),

    FROM summary
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("artist_id") >= 9)

        "artist_id",
        "title",

    )

    .filter(F.col("a.debut_year") >= 1996)

w_all_by_artist_debut_year = Window.orderBy(F.col("artist_debut_year").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
w_release_date_year_by_release = Window.partitionBy(F.year("release_date")).orderBy("release_date", "id")
with_trends = (

    .select(

        F.round(F.col("artist_debut_year") - F.avg("artist_debut_year").over(w_artist_id), 2).alias("artist_debut_year_vs_artist_id_avg"),
```

```sql
    -- Scope the meter_readings rows
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        voltage,
        quality,
        CASE WHEN voltage >= 235.8 THEN 'large' WHEN voltage >= 222.1 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS voltage_tier
    FROM meter_readings
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per voltage_tier, quality
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        voltage,
        quality,
        voltage_tier
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY voltage_tier, quality ORDER BY kwh DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM cleaned
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
joined_site AS (
    -- Join sites
    SELECT
        s.*,
        si.site_name,
        si.zone AS site_zone,
        si.installed_kw AS site_installed_kw
    FROM deduped s
    JOIN sites si ON si.id = s.site_id
    WHERE si.zone IS NOT NULL
),
site_zone_stats AS (
    -- Max voltage per site_zone
    SELECT site_zone, MAX(voltage) AS max_voltage
    FROM joined_site
    GROUP BY site_zone
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_voltage,
        ROUND(s.voltage - g.max_voltage, 2) AS voltage_minus_max
    FROM joined_site s
    JOIN site_zone_stats g ON g.site_zone = s.site_zone
    WHERE s.voltage = g.max_voltage
)
-- Subtotals with ROLLUP
SELECT
    voltage_tier,
    site_id,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level,
    MAX(read_at) AS last_read_at
FROM above_average
GROUP BY ROLLUP(voltage_tier, site_id)
ORDER BY voltage_tier NULLS LAST, site_id NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_meter_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.when(F.col("voltage") >= 235.8, "large").when(F.col("voltage") >= 222.1, "medium").otherwise("small").alias("voltage_tier"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("recency_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("voltage_tier", "quality").orderBy(F.col("kwh").desc(), F.col("id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("recency_rank") == 1)
    .drop("recency_rank")
)

    .filter(F.col("si.zone").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "si.site_name",
        F.col("si.zone").alias("site_zone"),
        F.col("si.installed_kw").alias("site_installed_kw"),
    )
)

site_zone_stats = (
    joined_site
    .groupBy("site_zone")
    .agg(F.max("voltage").alias("max_voltage"))
)

above_average = (

    .join(site_zone_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.site_zone") == F.col("s.site_zone"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.voltage") == F.col("g.max_voltage"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.max_voltage",
        F.round(F.col("s.voltage") - F.col("g.max_voltage"), 2).alias("voltage_minus_max"),
    )
)

result = (
    above_average
    .rollup("voltage_tier", "site_id")
    .agg(
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level"),
        F.max("read_at").alias("last_read_at"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("voltage_tier").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("site_id").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
```

```sql
    -- Filter adjusters
    SELECT
        id,
        adjuster_name,
        team,
        level
    FROM adjusters
    WHERE adjuster_name IS NOT NULL
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per team
    SELECT
        id,
        adjuster_name,
        team,
        level
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY level DESC, id DESC) AS row_num
        FROM base_adjusters
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY level DESC), 3) AS level_cume_dist,
        ROUND(level / NULLIF(SUM(level) OVER (PARTITION BY team, level), 0), 4) AS level_share_of_team_level,
        SUM(level) OVER (PARTITION BY team, level) AS team_level_sum_level,
        FIRST_VALUE(level) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY team, level ORDER BY level DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_level
    FROM latest
),
labeled AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(level / NULLIF(level_cume_dist, 0), 3) AS level_per_level_cume_dist,
        COALESCE(team, 'UNKNOWN') AS team_or_unknown
    FROM with_trends
    WHERE team IN ('Health', 'Motor', 'Travel')
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM labeled
    WHERE level > (SELECT AVG(level) FROM labeled)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    adjuster_name,
    level_share_of_team_level,
    team_level_sum_level,
    first_known_level,
    level_per_level_cume_dist,
    UPPER(TRIM(team_or_unknown)) AS team_or_unknown_clean
FROM screened
ORDER BY adjuster_name NULLS LAST, id
LIMIT 5
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base_adjusters = (
    df_adjusters
    .filter(F.col("adjuster_name").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "adjuster_name",
        "team",
        "level",
    )
)

latest = (
    base_adjusters
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("team").orderBy(F.col("level").desc(), F.col("id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

with_trends = (

    .select(

        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("level").desc())), 3).alias("level_cume_dist"),
        F.round(F.col("level") / F.nullif(F.sum("level").over(Window.partitionBy("team", "level")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("level_share_of_team_level"),
        F.sum("level").over(Window.partitionBy("team", "level")).alias("team_level_sum_level"),
        F.first("level", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("team", "level").orderBy(F.col("level").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_level"),

    .select(

        F.coalesce(F.col("team"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("team_or_unknown"),
    )

        "adjuster_name",
        "level_share_of_team_level",
        "team_level_sum_level",
        "first_known_level",
        "level_per_level_cume_dist",
```

```sql
        MIN(kwh) AS min_kwh,
        SUM(voltage) FILTER (WHERE zone IN ('Z4', 'Z2')) AS voltage_zone_in_z4_z2
```

```python
        "s.read_at",
        "s.voltage",
        "s.quality",
        F.col("si.tariff").alias("site_tariff"),
        "si.site_name",
    )
)

    combined_details_site
    .select(

        F.sum("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("read_at"))).alias("read_at_year_sum_voltage"),

    .filter(F.col("site_id") <= 4)
    .select(

        F.when(F.col("quality").isin("BAD", "OK"), "group_a").when(F.col("quality") == "EST", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("quality_group"),
```

```sql
    FROM joined_holder

ranked_2 AS (
```

```sql
    FROM enriched_warehouse
```

```sql
    SELECT warehouse_id, COUNT(*) AS transfer_count, SUM(qty) AS transfer_total_qty
    FROM stock_moves
    WHERE move_type = 'TRANSFER'
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
),
outbound_by_warehouse AS (
    -- OUTBOUND rows per warehouse_id
    SELECT warehouse_id, COUNT(*) AS outbound_count, SUM(qty) AS outbound_total_qty
    FROM stock_moves
    WHERE move_type = 'OUTBOUND'
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.warehouse_id, b.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_id,
    COALESCE(a.transfer_count, 0) AS transfer_count,
    a.transfer_total_qty,
    COALESCE(b.outbound_count, 0) AS outbound_count,
    COALESCE(b.outbound_total_qty, 0) AS outbound_total_qty,
    COALESCE(a.transfer_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.outbound_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM transfer_by_warehouse a
FULL OUTER JOIN outbound_by_warehouse b
  ON a.warehouse_id = b.warehouse_id
ORDER BY warehouse_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

transfer_by_warehouse = (
    df_stock_moves
    .filter(F.col("move_type") == "TRANSFER")
    .groupBy("warehouse_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("transfer_count"),
        F.sum("qty").alias("transfer_total_qty"),
    )
)

outbound_by_warehouse = (
    df_stock_moves
    .filter(F.col("move_type") == "OUTBOUND")
    .groupBy("warehouse_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("outbound_count"),
        F.sum("qty").alias("outbound_total_qty"),
    )
)

result = (
    transfer_by_warehouse.alias("a")
    .join(outbound_by_warehouse.alias("b"), F.col("a.warehouse_id") == F.col("b.warehouse_id"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.warehouse_id"), F.col("b.warehouse_id")).alias("warehouse_id"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.transfer_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("transfer_count"),
        F.col("a.transfer_total_qty"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.outbound_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("outbound_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.outbound_total_qty"), F.lit(0)).alias("outbound_total_qty"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.transfer_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.outbound_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("warehouse_id")
)
```

```sql
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.policy_id,
        a.claim_date,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_180d,
        SUM(b.claimed_amount) AS prior_claimed_amount_180d
    FROM claims a
    LEFT JOIN claims b
      ON b.policy_id = a.policy_id
     AND b.claim_date < a.claim_date
     AND b.claim_date >= DATE_SUB(a.claim_date, 180)
    GROUP BY a.id, a.policy_id, a.claim_date
),
windowed AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(prior_claimed_amount_180d - AVG(prior_claimed_amount_180d) OVER w_policy_id, 2) AS prior_claimed_amount_180d_vs_policy_id_avg,
        ROUND(prior_claimed_amount_180d / NULLIF(SUM(prior_claimed_amount_180d) OVER (PARTITION BY policy_id), 0), 4) AS prior_claimed_amount_180d_share_of_policy_id,
        ROUND(AVG(prior_rows_180d) OVER (PARTITION BY policy_id), 2) AS policy_id_avg_prior_rows_180d,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY prior_rows_180d DESC), 3) AS prior_rows_180d_cume_dist,
        DATEDIFF(claim_date, LAG(claim_date) OVER (ORDER BY prior_rows_180d, id)) AS days_since_prev_claim_date
    FROM in_window
    WINDOW w_policy_id AS (PARTITION BY policy_id)
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Rows that have matching claims
    SELECT s.*
    FROM windowed s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM claims c
            WHERE c.policy_id = s.policy_id
        )
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Rows that have matching claims
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_activity s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM claims c
            WHERE c.policy_id = s.policy_id
              AND c.claim_date IS NOT NULL
        )
)
SELECT
    id,
    policy_id,
    claim_date,
    prior_rows_180d,
    prior_claimed_amount_180d,
    prior_claimed_amount_180d_vs_policy_id_avg,
    prior_claimed_amount_180d_share_of_policy_id,
    policy_id_avg_prior_rows_180d,
    prior_rows_180d_cume_dist,
    days_since_prev_claim_date,
    DATE_FORMAT(claim_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS claim_date_label
FROM without_matches
ORDER BY policy_id_avg_prior_rows_180d DESC, claim_date DESC NULLS FIRST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

in_window = (
    df_claims.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_claims.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.policy_id") == F.col("a.policy_id"))
        & (F.col("b.claim_date") < F.col("a.claim_date"))
        & (F.col("b.claim_date") >= F.date_sub(F.col("a.claim_date"), 180)),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.policy_id", "a.claim_date")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_180d"),
        F.sum("b.claimed_amount").alias("prior_claimed_amount_180d"),
    )
)

w_policy_id = Window.partitionBy("policy_id")
windowed = (
    in_window
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("prior_claimed_amount_180d") - F.avg("prior_claimed_amount_180d").over(w_policy_id), 2).alias("prior_claimed_amount_180d_vs_policy_id_avg"),
        F.round(F.col("prior_claimed_amount_180d") / F.nullif(F.sum("prior_claimed_amount_180d").over(Window.partitionBy("policy_id")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("prior_claimed_amount_180d_share_of_policy_id"),
        F.round(F.avg("prior_rows_180d").over(Window.partitionBy("policy_id")), 2).alias("policy_id_avg_prior_rows_180d"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("prior_rows_180d").desc())), 3).alias("prior_rows_180d_cume_dist"),
        F.datediff(F.col("claim_date"), F.lag("claim_date").over(Window.orderBy("prior_rows_180d", "id"))).alias("days_since_prev_claim_date"),
    )
)

with_activity = (
    windowed.alias("s")
    .join(df_claims.alias("c"), F.col("c.policy_id") == F.col("s.policy_id"), "left_semi")
)

without_matches = (
    with_activity.alias("s")
    .join(df_claims.alias("c"), (F.col("c.policy_id") == F.col("s.policy_id")) & (F.col("c.claim_date").isNotNull()), "left_semi")
)

result = (
    without_matches
    .select(
        "id",
        "policy_id",
        "claim_date",
        "prior_rows_180d",
        "prior_claimed_amount_180d",
        "prior_claimed_amount_180d_vs_policy_id_avg",
        "prior_claimed_amount_180d_share_of_policy_id",
        "policy_id_avg_prior_rows_180d",
        "prior_rows_180d_cume_dist",
        "days_since_prev_claim_date",
        F.date_format(F.col("claim_date"), "yyyy-MM").alias("claim_date_label"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("policy_id_avg_prior_rows_180d").desc(),
        F.col("claim_date").desc_nulls_first(),
    )
)
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.fail_count, 0) AS fail_count,
    COALESCE(a.fail_avg_score, 0) AS fail_avg_score,
    COALESCE(b.withdrawn_count, 0) AS withdrawn_count,
    COALESCE(b.withdrawn_total_score, 0) AS withdrawn_total_score,
    COALESCE(a.fail_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.withdrawn_count, 0) AS fail_count_minus_withdrawn_count
FROM fail_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN withdrawn_monthly b
  ON a.enrolled_at_month = b.enrolled_at_month
ORDER BY enrolled_at_month
```

```python
)
```

```sql
    WINDOW w_claim_type_reported_at_month AS (PARTITION BY claim_type, MONTH(reported_at) ORDER BY claimed_amount DESC, id)

sequenced AS (
```

```sql
enriched AS (
```

```python
grouped = (
    recent_tickets
    .groupBy("priority")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("requester_id") / F.nullif(F.sum("csat"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("requester_id_to_csat_ratio"),
        F.percentile_approx("csat", 0.5).alias("median_csat"),

    .withColumn("priority_ref", F.concat(F.col("priority"), F.lit("#"), F.col("n_rows").cast("string")))
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("status", "store_id").orderBy("seq_no", "id")
w_recent = Window.partitionBy(F.year("order_date"), "channel").orderBy(F.col("next_seq_no").asc_nulls_last())

scored = (
    df_orders
    .withColumn("running_discount", F.sum("discount").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "order_date"), "customer_id").orderBy("order_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("discount", "id")))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("amount", "id")))
)

eligible = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_order_items.alias("x"), (F.col("x.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.order_id").isin([9, 12, 24])), "left_anti")
)

enriched = (
    eligible
    .filter(F.col("seq_no").isNull())
    .withColumn("next_event_seq", F.lead("event_seq").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("next_seq_no", F.lead("seq_no").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("seq_no_2", F.row_number().over(w_grp))
)

scored_orders = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("running_max_running_discount", F.max("running_discount").over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("next_event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_count_running_discount", F.count("running_discount").over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("next_event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_sum_running_discount", F.sum("running_discount").over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("next_event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("next_discount", F.lead("discount", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("seq_no_2", "id")))
)

scored_orders_2 = (
    scored_orders
    .select(
        "id",
        "discount",
        "shipping_fee",
        "seq_no",
        "next_seq_no",
        "running_max_running_discount",
        "next_discount",
        F.cume_dist().over(w_recent).alias("next_seq_no_cume_dist"),
        F.max("running_max_running_discount").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("order_date"), "channel")).alias("order_date_month_max_running_max_running_discount"),
    )
)

with_latest = (
    scored_orders_2
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_payments.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.amount").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))

    .select("s.*", F.col("c.method"), F.col("c.paid_at"))
)

    with_latest
    .select("id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_orders
        .filter(F.col("channel").isin(["mobile", "partner"]))
        .select("id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    with_latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .select(
        "id",
        "shipping_fee",
        "seq_no",
        "next_seq_no",
        "running_max_running_discount",
        "next_discount",
        "next_seq_no_cume_dist",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent_readings = df_meter_readings.filter(F.col("kwh") <= 92.5)

site_id_stats = (
    recent_readings
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("voltage", 0.5).alias("median_voltage"))
)

above_average = (
    recent_readings.alias("s")
    .join(site_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.voltage") >= F.col("g.median_voltage"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.median_voltage",
        F.round(F.col("s.voltage") - F.col("g.median_voltage"), 2).alias("voltage_minus_median"),
    )
)

w_read_at_month_site_id_by_med_3 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("read_at"), "site_id").orderBy(F.col("median_voltage").desc(), "id")
windowed = (
    above_average
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("read_at"), "site_id").orderBy(F.col("median_voltage").desc())).alias("median_voltage_dense_rank"),
        F.round(F.avg("voltage_minus_median").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("read_at"), "site_id").orderBy(F.col("median_voltage").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-1, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("voltage_minus_median_avg_2"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w_read_at_month_site_id_by_med_3).alias("median_voltage_quintile"),
        (F.col("kwh") - F.lag("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("quality", F.to_date("read_at")).orderBy("voltage_minus_median", "id"))).alias("kwh_change"),
    )
)

w_quality = Window.partitionBy("quality")
sequenced = (
    windowed
    .select(
        "id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "median_voltage_dense_rank",
        "voltage_minus_median_avg_2",
        "kwh_change",
        F.round(F.col("kwh") - F.avg("kwh").over(w_quality), 2).alias("kwh_vs_quality_avg"),
        F.round(F.col("kwh_change") - F.avg("kwh_change").over(w_quality), 2).alias("kwh_change_vs_quality_avg"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_quality).alias("rows_in_quality"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    sequenced
    .select(
        "*",
        F.nth_value("rows_in_quality", 2).over(Window.orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_rows_in_quality"),
        F.last("kwh").over(Window.orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_kwh"),
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("rows_in_quality").desc(), "id")).alias("rows_in_quality_decile"),
        F.last("median_voltage_dense_rank", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_median_voltage_dense_rank"),
    )
)

    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        F.col("second_rows_in_quality").alias("m_second_rows_in_quality"),
        F.col("median_voltage_dense_rank").alias("m_median_voltage_dense_rank"),
        F.col("rows_in_quality_decile").alias("rows_in_quality_decile_v"),
        F.col("rows_in_quality").alias("m_rows_in_quality"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id"],
        values=["m_second_rows_in_quality", "m_median_voltage_dense_rank", "rows_in_quality_decile_v", "m_rows_in_quality"],
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
```

```python
cleaned = (
    df_employees
    .filter((F.col("hire_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-08-25"))) & (F.col("level") != "L3"))
    .withColumn("level_lower", F.lower("level"))
)

ranked = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("manager_id", "dept_id").orderBy(F.col("hire_date").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)

    .filter(F.col("d.dept_name").isin(["Legal", "Engineering"]))

)
```

```sql
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.track_id, b.track_id) AS track_id,
    COALESCE(a.desktop_count, 0) AS desktop_count,
    COALESCE(a.desktop_avg_ms_played, 0) AS desktop_avg_ms_played,
    COALESCE(b.car_count, 0) AS car_count,
    COALESCE(b.car_total_ms_played, 0) AS car_total_ms_played,
    COALESCE(a.desktop_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.car_count, 0) AS desktop_count_minus_car_count
FROM desktop_by_track a
FULL OUTER JOIN car_by_track b
  ON a.track_id = b.track_id
ORDER BY track_id
```

```sql
),
profiled AS (

    SELECT

    FROM in_window s
```

```python
    .select(
```

```python
        F.when(F.col("txn_type") == "CREDIT", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_credit"),
    )
)

latest = (

    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("account_id", "merchant").orderBy("amount", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

metrics = (
    latest
    .withColumn("amount_avg_6", F.avg("amount").over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy(F.col("is_credit").desc(), "id")))
```

```sql
    -- TRANSFER rows per moved_at_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', moved_at) AS moved_at_month, COUNT(*) AS transfer_count, ROUND(AVG(qty), 2) AS transfer_avg_qty

    FROM stock_moves
    WHERE move_type = 'OUTBOUND'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', moved_at)
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.moved_at_month, b.moved_at_month) AS moved_at_month,
    COALESCE(a.transfer_count, 0) AS transfer_count,
    a.transfer_avg_qty,
    COALESCE(b.outbound_count, 0) AS outbound_count,
    b.outbound_avg_qty,
    COALESCE(a.transfer_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.outbound_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM transfer_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN outbound_monthly b
  ON a.moved_at_month = b.moved_at_month
ORDER BY moved_at_month
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("move_type") == "TRANSFER")

    .agg(

        F.round(F.avg("qty"), 2).alias("outbound_avg_qty"),
    )
)

    .join(outbound_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.moved_at_month") == F.col("b.moved_at_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.moved_at_month"), F.col("b.moved_at_month")).alias("moved_at_month"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("amount", "id", "promo_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_ordered = Window.orderBy("discount_pct", "id", "promo_id", "subscription_id")

cleaned = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & F.col("store_id").isin([20, 34, 36]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "channel",
        "amount",
        "discount",
        F.col("shipping_fee").cast("int").alias("shipping_fee_int"),
        (F.col("amount") * F.col("discount")).alias("amount_times_discount"),
    )
)

matched = (
    cleaned
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("a.channel").eqNullSafe(F.col("pr.channel"))) & (F.col("a.order_date") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("a.order_date") < F.col("pr.ends_on") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    matched
    .withColumn("running_count_discount_pct", F.count("discount_pct").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("running_avg_discount_pct", F.avg("discount_pct").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("running_min_discount_pct", F.min("discount_pct").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("next_shipping_fee_int", F.lead("shipping_fee_int", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("store_id", "promo_code").orderBy("discount_pct", "id", "promo_id")))
)

matched_orders = (
    enriched
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("src.order_date") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("src.order_date") <= F.date_add(F.col("sub.end_date"), 7)), "left")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee"),
    )
)

cleaned_orders = (
    matched_orders
    .filter((F.col("order_date") >= F.lit("2023-07-17").cast("date")) & (F.col("status") == "COMPLETED"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("amount_times_discount") >= 88, "High").when(F.col("amount_times_discount") >= 30, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("amount_times_discount_tier"),
        F.coalesce("promo_code", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("promo_code_filled"),
    )
)

    cleaned_orders
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("shipping_fee_int").over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("amount_times_discount", "id", "promo_id", "subscription_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_shipping_fee_int"),
        F.lead("amount", 1).over(w_ordered).alias("next_amount"),
        F.round((F.col("subscription_id") / F.sum("subscription_id").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("order_date"), "status"))), 4).alias("subscription_id_share"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "order_date").alias("week_start"))
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("channel_list"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "COMPLETED", F.col("amount_times_discount"))).alias("completed_total_amount_times_discount"),
        F.round(F.sum("running_avg_discount_pct") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("plan") == "premium", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("running_avg_discount_pct_per_premium"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("plan") == "enterprise", 1)).alias("enterprise_rows"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("plan") == "enterprise", F.col("next_amount")).otherwise(0)).alias("enterprise_next_amount"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("channel") == "mobile", F.col("cumulative_shipping_fee_int"))).alias("mobile_max_cumulative_shipping_fee_int"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("enterprise_rows") > 1)
)
```

```sql
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY humidity_plus_temp_c DESC, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM islands

    WHERE dedup_rank = 1

with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        firmware,

        is_new_burst,
        LAG(humidity_plus_temp_c, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY humidity, id) AS prev_humidity_plus_temp_c,
        LEAD(is_new_burst, 1) OVER (ORDER BY pressure, id) AS next_is_new_burst
    FROM latest

    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER

)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    device_code,
    CASE WHEN prev_humidity_plus_temp_c >= 69 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS prev_humidity_plus_temp_c_tier,
    STDDEV_SAMP(humidity) AS humidity_stddev,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(next_is_new_burst, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS next_is_new_burst_quartiles,
    AVG(prev_humidity_plus_temp_c) AS avg_prev_humidity_plus_temp_c,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE device_code = 'DV-03') AS dv_03_rows,
    ROUND(SUM(humidity) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN device_code = 'DV-04' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS humidity_per_dv_04,
    COUNT_IF(device_code = 'DV-02') AS dv_02_events
```

```python
    .withColumn("humidity_plus_temp_c", (F.col("humidity") + F.col("temp_c")))

    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 20 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = with_gaps.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

latest = (
    islands
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("humidity_plus_temp_c").desc(), "id")))

        "humidity",

)

    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("pressure").desc_nulls_first(), "id")))
```

```python
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("quality")), " ", "_")).alias("quality_slug"),
        F.concat(F.col("quality"), F.lit("#"), F.col("site_id").cast("string")).alias("quality_ref"),

    )

    cleaned
    .crossJoin(cleaned.agg(F.avg("kwh").alias("overall_avg_kwh")))

        F.last("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", F.date_trunc("month", "read_at")).orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_voltage"),
        F.sum("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id")).alias("site_id_sum_voltage"),
        F.round(F.col("days_since_read_at") / F.nullif(F.sum("days_since_read_at").over(w_site_id), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("days_since_read_at_share_of_site_id"),
        F.sum("days_since_read_at").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", F.date_trunc("month", "read_at")).orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_days_since_read_at"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    ranked.alias("s")
```

```python
        "reading_ts",
```

```sql
    SELECT
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared_plays = (
    df_plays
    .filter((F.col("played_at") < F.lit("2025-03-02 11:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (F.col("is_skipped")))

)

w_is_skipped = Window.partitionBy("is_skipped")
w_all_by_played_at_ties = Window.orderBy("played_at")
w_played_at_month = Window.partitionBy("played_at_month")
with_trends = (
    prepared_plays
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("is_skipped")).alias("rows_in_is_skipped"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("played_at_month")).alias("rows_in_played_at_month"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("listener_id").orderBy(F.col("played_at_month").desc(), "id")), 3).alias("played_at_month_percent_rank"),
        F.round(F.avg("played_at_month").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("played_at_month").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)), 2).alias("played_at_month_avg_6_prior"),
        F.round(F.col("played_at_month") / F.nullif(F.sum("played_at_month").over(w_is_skipped), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("played_at_month_share_of_is_skipped"),

        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("played_at_month").desc())), 3).alias("played_at_month_cume_dist"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("listener_id").over(Window.partitionBy("played_at_month"))).alias("distinct_listener_id_in_played_at_month"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_trends
    .select(
        "id",
        "listener_id",
        "played_at",
        "is_skipped",
        "source",
        "source_slug",
        "rows_in_is_skipped",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared_claims = df_claims

with_details = (
    prepared_claims.alias("s")
    .join(df_adjusters.alias("a"), F.col("a.id") == F.col("s.adjuster_id"), "left")
    .select(

        "s.policy_id",
        "s.adjuster_id",
        "s.claim_date",
        "s.claim_type",
        "s.claimed_amount",
        "s.status",
        F.col("a.team").alias("adjuster_team"),
    )
)

w_adjuster_id = Window.partitionBy("adjuster_id")
w_all_by_claim_date = Window.orderBy("claim_date", "id")
metrics = (
    with_details
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_adjuster_id).alias("rows_in_adjuster_id"),
        (F.col("claimed_amount") - F.lag("claimed_amount").over(w_all_by_claim_date)).alias("claimed_amount_change"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "claim_date"), "adjuster_id").orderBy(F.col("claim_date").asc_nulls_last())).alias("claim_date_dense_rank"),
        F.max("claimed_amount").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "claim_date"), "adjuster_id").orderBy(F.col("claim_date").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_claimed_amount_so_far"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("adjuster_team").orderBy(F.col("claim_date").desc(), "id")).alias("rn"),
        F.lead("claimed_amount", 1, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("adjuster_team").orderBy(F.col("claim_date").desc(), "id")).alias("next_claimed_amount"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("claim_type").over(Window.partitionBy("adjuster_id"))).alias("distinct_claim_type_in_adjuster_id"),
        F.lag("claim_date").over(Window.partitionBy("adjuster_team", "adjuster_id").orderBy("claim_date", "id")).alias("prev_claim_date"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("adjuster_team", "policy_id")).alias("rows_in_adjuster_team_policy_id"),
    )
)

leaders = metrics.filter(F.col("rn") == 1)

w_claim_date_dense_rank = Window.partitionBy("claim_date_dense_rank")
w_status_claim_date_year_by_pr_2 = Window.partitionBy("status", F.year("claim_date")).orderBy("prev_claim_date", "id")
with_windows = (
    leaders
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("max_claimed_amount_so_far") / F.nullif(F.sum("max_claimed_amount_so_far").over(Window.partitionBy("claim_date_dense_rank")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("max_claimed_amount_so_far_share_of_claim_date_de"),
        F.nth_value("rn", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("status", F.year("claim_date")).orderBy("prev_claim_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_rn"),
        F.lead("claim_date").over(Window.orderBy("rn", "id")).alias("next_claim_date"),
        F.lead("claim_date_dense_rank").over(Window.partitionBy("status", F.year("claim_date")).orderBy("prev_claim_date", "id")).alias("next_claim_date_dense_rank"),

        F.last("rn", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("status", F.year("claim_date")).orderBy("prev_claim_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_rn"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("status", F.year("claim_date")).orderBy("prev_claim_date", "id")).alias("prev_claim_date_quintile"),
    )
)

        "next_claim_date_dense_rank",
        "next3_rn",
        "last_known_rn",

)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
```

```python
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("cost") >= 74)
    .select(

        "order_id",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",

    )

    .select(

        F.round((F.col("cost") / F.sum("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("status"))), 4).alias("cost_share"),
```

```sql
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        CAST(paid_at AS DATE) AS paid_at_day,
        COALESCE(method, 'DIRECT') AS method_filled
    FROM payments
    WHERE method IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (

        *,
        AVG(amount) OVER w_running AS running_avg_amount,
        MAX(amount) OVER w_running AS running_max_amount,
        MIN(amount) OVER w_running AS running_min_amount
    FROM filtered

),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY amount DESC, id) AS rn
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
enriched_payments AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        method,
        paid_at,
        running_max_amount,
        AVG(running_avg_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS running_avg_amount_avg_2_prior,
        FIRST_VALUE(running_max_amount, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at_day, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_running_max_amount,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY running_max_amount NULLS FIRST) AS running_max_amount_cume_dist
    FROM ranked
),
flagged AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR paid_at > LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) + INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM enriched_payments
),
islands AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
)
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', paid_at) AS year_start,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(method)) AS num_methods,
    COUNT_IF(method = 'bank_transfer') AS bank_transfer_events,
    ROUND(AVG(running_max_amount), 2) AS avg_running_max_amount,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(running_max_amount, 0.95) AS running_max_amount_p95
FROM islands
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY bank_transfer_events;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("method").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        F.col("paid_at").cast("date").alias("paid_at_day"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("method_filled"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("amount").over(w_running).alias("running_avg_amount"),
        F.max("amount").over(w_running).alias("running_max_amount"),
        F.min("amount").over(w_running).alias("running_min_amount"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

enriched_payments = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        "paid_at",
        "running_max_amount",
        F.avg("running_avg_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("running_avg_amount_avg_2_prior"),
        F.first("running_max_amount", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at_day", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_running_max_amount"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("running_max_amount").asc_nulls_first())).alias("running_max_amount_cume_dist"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    enriched_payments
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w_running))

result = (
    islands
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "paid_at").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("method")).alias("num_methods"),
        F.count_if(F.col("method") == "bank_transfer").alias("bank_transfer_events"),
        F.round(F.avg("running_max_amount"), 2).alias("avg_running_max_amount"),
        F.percentile_approx("running_max_amount", 0.95).alias("running_max_amount_p95"),
    )
    .orderBy("bank_transfer_events")
)
```

```sql
    FROM ticket_events

    SELECT *, LAG(event_at) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_at, id) AS prev_event_at
    FROM prepared

    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 90 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_event_at IS NULL OR event_at > prev_event_at + INTERVAL 90 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        event_type,
        burst_id,
        MIN(event_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(event_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        SUM(event_type_len) AS session_event_type_len,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY event_type, burst_id
),
grouped AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        event_type,
        SUM(duration_min) FILTER (WHERE event_type <> 'escalated') AS duration_min_event_type_escalated,
        SUM(duration_min) AS total_duration_min,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(burst_id, 0.5) AS median_burst_id,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows
    FROM per_session
    GROUP BY 1
    HAVING SUM(session_event_type_len) > 24
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM grouped
    WHERE total_duration_min > (SELECT AVG(total_duration_min) FROM grouped)
)

    event_type,
    total_duration_min,
    n_rows,
    COALESCE(n_rows, 0) AS n_rows_filled
FROM screened
```

```sql
WITH in_window AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.agent_id,
        a.opened_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_1d,
        SUM(b.requester_id) AS prior_requester_id_1d
    FROM tickets a
    LEFT JOIN tickets b
      ON b.agent_id = a.agent_id
     AND b.opened_at < a.opened_at
     AND b.opened_at >= a.opened_at - INTERVAL 1 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.agent_id, a.opened_at
),
enriched AS (
    -- Join support_agents
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.agent_id,
        s.opened_at,
        s.prior_rows_1d,
        s.prior_requester_id_1d,
        su.hired_on AS agent_hired_on,
        su.agent_name
    FROM in_window s
    LEFT JOIN support_agents su ON su.id = s.agent_id
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        agent_id,
        opened_at,
        prior_rows_1d,
        agent_hired_on,
        FLOOR(prior_requester_id_1d / 25) * 25 AS prior_requester_id_1d_bucket,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(agent_name), 1, 2) AS agent_name_prefix
    FROM enriched
),
per_group AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        agent_id,
        ROUND(STDDEV(prior_rows_1d), 2) AS stddev_prior_rows_1d,
        MIN(agent_hired_on) AS first_agent_hired_on,
        COUNT(DISTINCT agent_id) AS distinct_agent_ids,
        MAX(prior_rows_1d) AS max_prior_rows_1d
    FROM annotated
    GROUP BY agent_id
    HAVING MAX(prior_rows_1d) > 1
)
SELECT
    max_prior_rows_1d,
    agent_id,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level,
    ROUND(AVG(stddev_prior_rows_1d), 2) AS avg_stddev_prior_rows_1d,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    SUM(max_prior_rows_1d) AS total_max_prior_rows_1d
FROM per_group
GROUP BY ROLLUP(max_prior_rows_1d, agent_id)
```

```python
    df_tickets.alias("a")

        & (F.col("b.opened_at") < F.col("a.opened_at"))
        & (F.col("b.opened_at") >= F.col("a.opened_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.agent_id", "a.opened_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_1d"),
        F.sum("b.requester_id").alias("prior_requester_id_1d"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    in_window.alias("s")
    .join(df_support_agents.alias("su"), F.col("su.id") == F.col("s.agent_id"), "left")

        "s.id",
        "s.agent_id",
        "s.opened_at",

        "s.prior_requester_id_1d",
```

```python
    df_tickets

        "opened_at",
        "priority",
        "channel",
        "csat",
        "tags",

    )
)

w_agent_id = Window.partitionBy("agent_id")
w_priority_by_requester_id = Window.partitionBy("priority").orderBy("requester_id", "id")
w_all_by_csat_ties = Window.orderBy(F.col("csat").desc())
ranked = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("requester_id").over(w_agent_id).alias("agent_id_max_requester_id"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("priority").orderBy("requester_id", "id")), 3).alias("requester_id_cume_dist"),
        F.lead("csat").over(Window.partitionBy("priority").orderBy("requester_id", "id")).alias("next_csat"),
        F.lead("requester_id", 3).over(w_priority_by_requester_id).alias("next3_requester_id"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("channel").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id"))).alias("distinct_channel_in_agent_id"),
        F.round(F.avg("requester_id").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("csat").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)), 2).alias("requester_id_avg_6_prior"),
        F.last("csat", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("csat").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_csat"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id")).alias("rows_in_agent_id"),
        F.rank().over(w_all_by_csat_ties).alias("csat_rank"),
        F.last("requester_id").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("csat").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_requester_id"),
    )
)

top_per_group = ranked.filter((F.col("csat_rank") <= 3) & (F.col("requester_id") < 17))

grouped = (

    .groupBy("distinct_channel_in_agent_id")

        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("priority")).alias("priority_list"),
        F.round(F.sum("requester_id_avg_6_prior") / F.nullif(F.sum("csat_rank"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("requester_id_avg_6_prior_to_csat_rank_ratio"),

    .select(
```

```python
        "holder_id",
        "product",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "status",
        F.add_months(F.col("start_date"), 12).alias("start_date_plus_12m"),

)

joined_holder = (
    filtered.alias("s")
    .join(df_policyholders.alias("p"), F.col("p.id") == F.col("s.holder_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.holder_id",
        "s.product",
        "s.end_date",
        "s.status",
        "s.start_date_plus_12m",
        F.col("p.risk_score").alias("holder_risk_score"),

)

w_end_date_year_by_start_date = Window.partitionBy(F.year("end_date")).orderBy("start_date_plus_12m", "id")

    .select(
        "*",
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("start_date_plus_12m"))).alias("rows_in_start_date_plus_12m_year"),
        F.first("start_date_plus_12m", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("status", "holder_id").orderBy("holder_risk_score", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_start_date_plus_12m"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("product").orderBy(F.col("holder_risk_score").desc(), "id")).alias("holder_risk_score_dense_rank"),
        F.lead("end_date", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("status", "holder_id").orderBy("holder_risk_score", "id")).alias("next2_end_date"),
        F.lead("end_date").over(Window.orderBy("start_date_plus_12m", "id")).alias("next_end_date"),
        F.max("holder_risk_score").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("start_date_plus_12m"))).alias("start_date_plus_12m_year_max_holder_risk_score"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("status", "holder_id").orderBy("holder_risk_score")), 3).alias("holder_risk_score_percent_rank"),
        F.nth_value("end_date", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("status", "holder_id").orderBy("holder_risk_score", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_end_date"),
        F.max("holder_risk_score").over(Window.partitionBy("product").orderBy(F.col("holder_risk_score").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_holder_risk_score_so_far"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_end_date_year_by_start_date), 3).alias("start_date_plus_12m_percent_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w_status_holder_id_by_holder_r_3).alias("holder_risk_score_rank"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("status").over(Window.partitionBy("holder_id", "product"))).alias("distinct_status_in_holder_id_product"),
        F.round(F.col("holder_risk_score") - F.avg("holder_risk_score").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("start_date_plus_12m"))), 2).alias("holder_risk_score_vs_start_date_plus_12m_year_av"),
        F.round(F.avg("holder_risk_score").over(Window.partitionBy("status", "holder_id").orderBy("holder_risk_score", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("holder_risk_score_avg_4"),
        F.round(F.avg("holder_risk_score").over(Window.partitionBy("holder_id", "product")), 2).alias("holder_id_product_avg_holder_risk_score"),
    )
)

        F.abs(F.col("holder_risk_score_avg_4") - 0.5).alias("holder_risk_score_avg_4_distance"),
        F.greatest(F.col("holder_risk_score_avg_4"), F.col("holder_risk_score_rank")).alias("greatest_holder_risk_score_avg_4_holder_risk_sco"),
    )
)
```

```sql
        FROM unique_rows
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1

plan_stats AS (
    -- Max birth_year per plan
    SELECT plan, MAX(birth_year) AS max_birth_year
    FROM unique_rows_2
    GROUP BY plan
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_birth_year,
        ROUND(s.birth_year - g.max_birth_year, 2) AS birth_year_minus_max
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("session_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("account_id").isin([21, 23, 24, 25]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.trim("merchant").alias("clean_merchant"),
        F.concat_ws(",", "merchant", "txn_type").alias("merchant_txn_type_key"),
        F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_merchant"),
    )
)

joined = (
    valid
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("a"), F.col("e.account_id") == F.col("a.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("a.balance"), F.col("a.account_type"))
)

flagged = (
    joined
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("txn_time").over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.lag("txn_time").over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

with_windows = (
    islands
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "merchant",
        "clean_merchant",
        "merchant_txn_type_key",
        "balance",
        "account_type",
        F.max("balance").over(w_recent).alias("running_max_balance"),
        F.min("balance").over(w_recent).alias("running_min_balance"),
        F.avg("balance").over(w_recent).alias("running_avg_balance"),
        F.lag("amount", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("txn_type", "account_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")).alias("prev_amount"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("a"), F.col("src.account_id") == F.col("a.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("a.account_type").isin(["CREDIT", "CHECKING", "SAVINGS"]))
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("a.opened_date"),
        F.col("a.balance").alias("account_balance"),
        F.col("a.status"),
    )
)

latest = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("running_max_balance").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

result = (
    latest
    .rollup(
        F.when(F.col("running_min_balance") >= 70000, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("running_min_balance_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("YEAR", "opened_date").alias("year_start"),

        F.avg(F.when(F.col("status") == "CLOSED", F.col("running_max_balance"))).alias("closed_avg_running_max_balance"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("status")).alias("num_status"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "CLOSED", 1)).alias("closed_count"),
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.car_count, 0) AS car_count,
    a.car_total_ms_played,
    COALESCE(b.phone_count, 0) AS phone_count,
    b.phone_total_ms_played,
    COALESCE(a.car_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.phone_count, 0) AS car_count_minus_phone_count
FROM car_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN phone_monthly b

ORDER BY played_at_month
```

```sql
    SELECT
```

```sql
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 90 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at > prev_closed_at + INTERVAL 90 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id ORDER BY closed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        agent_id,
        session_id,
        MIN(closed_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(closed_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(csat) AS session_csat,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(closed_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(closed_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY agent_id, session_id
),
ranked AS (

        agent_id,
        session_id,
        session_start,
        session_end,
        events,
        session_csat,
        duration_min,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY session_end, agent_id, session_id) AS session_end_dense_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY events) AS rows_in_events,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(agent_id) OVER (PARTITION BY events)) AS distinct_agent_id_in_events,
        duration_min - LAG(duration_min) OVER (ORDER BY session_end, agent_id, session_id) AS duration_min_change
    FROM sessions
)
SELECT
    session_id,
    events,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(session_csat, 0.5) AS median_session_csat,
    SUM(distinct_agent_id_in_events) AS total_distinct_agent_id_in_events,
    MIN(session_start) AS first_session_start
FROM ranked
```

```sql
    FROM grouped
```

```sql
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS k, attr_value
),
ranked AS (

        FROM flattened
    ) t

    FROM ranked
),
islands AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY log_ts, id, k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
ranked_app_logs AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY service, k ORDER BY log_ts, id, k) AS rn
        FROM islands
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', log_ts) AS hour_window,
        CASE WHEN status_code >= 410 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS status_code_tier,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE k = 'version') AS version_rows,
        BIT_OR(status_code) AS status_code_bit_or,
        ROUND(AVG(session_id), 2) AS avg_session_id,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(session_id, 0.95) AS session_id_p95
    FROM ranked_app_logs
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    hour_window,
    status_code_tier,
    status_code_bit_or,
    avg_session_id
FROM summary
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    flattened
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("status_code")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

with_gaps = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("log_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k")).isNull() | (F.col("log_ts") > F.lag("log_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 1 HOUR")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

ranked_app_logs = (
    islands
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("service", "k").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

summary = (
    ranked_app_logs
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("HOUR", "log_ts").alias("hour_window"),

        F.percentile_approx("session_id", 0.95).alias("session_id_p95"),
    )

result = (
    summary
    .select("hour_window", "status_code_tier", "status_code_bit_or", "avg_session_id")
```

```python
    .withColumn("city_country", F.concat("city", F.lit(" - "), "country"))
)

metrics = (
    base
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc(), "id")))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc(), "id")))
    .withColumn("rating_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("rating").desc(), "id")))
)

with_latest = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.cost").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.launch_date"), F.col("c.stock_qty"))
)

metrics_suppliers = (
    with_latest
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("rating_bucket") / F.sum("rating_bucket").over(Window.partitionBy("country"))), 4).alias("rating_bucket_share"),
        F.round((F.col("event_seq") / F.sum("event_seq").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("launch_date"), "city"))), 4).alias("event_seq_share"),
        F.lead("stock_qty", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("event_seq", "id")).alias("next_stock_qty"),

    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull() & (F.col("rating_bucket_bucket") != 7))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("event_seq_share") + F.col("rating_bucket_share")).alias("event_seq_share_plus_rating_bucket_share"),
        F.round("next_stock_qty", 1).alias("next_stock_qty_rounded"),
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_city"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("days_since_opened_date", "id")

    .select(

        "customer_id",
        "days_since_opened_date",

        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("days_since_opened_date").desc(), "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.sum("days_since_opened_date").over(Window.partitionBy("status", "customer_id").orderBy("days_since_opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_days_since_opened_date_2"),
```

```python
w_event_type_by_event_at = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id")
ranked = (

    .select(

        F.nth_value("event_at", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_event_at"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("actor", "event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id")).alias("seq_no_2"),

w_event_at_tercile_seq_no_by_e = Window.partitionBy("event_at_tercile", "seq_no").orderBy(F.col("event_at").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.phone_count, 0) AS phone_count,
    COALESCE(a.phone_avg_ms_played, 0) AS phone_avg_ms_played,
    COALESCE(b.speaker_count, 0) AS speaker_count,
    COALESCE(b.speaker_total_ms_played, 0) AS speaker_total_ms_played,
    COALESCE(a.phone_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.speaker_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM phone_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN speaker_monthly b
  ON a.played_at_month = b.played_at_month
ORDER BY played_at_month
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        ticket_id,
        event_at,
        event_type,
        actor,
        DATE_FORMAT(event_at, 'MMM yyyy') AS event_at_label
    FROM ticket_events
    WHERE actor <> 'customer'
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event_at per actor
    SELECT *, LAG(event_at) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at, id) AS prev_event_at
    FROM filtered
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_event_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(event_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_event_at)) / 60 > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per event_type, actor
    SELECT
        id,
        ticket_id,
        event_at,
        event_type,
        actor,
        event_at_label,
        prev_event_at,
        starts_session,
        session_id
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_type, actor ORDER BY session_id DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM sessionized
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
ranked AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        ticket_id,
        event_at,
        event_at_label,
```

```sql
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        CAST(is_flagged AS INT) AS is_flagged_flag,
        COALESCE(merchant, 'DIRECT') AS merchant_filled
    FROM transactions
    WHERE txn_type = 'DEBIT'
      AND merchant IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(is_flagged_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, account_id ORDER BY is_flagged_flag, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_is_flagged_flag,
        MIN(is_flagged_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, account_id ORDER BY is_flagged_flag, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_is_flagged_flag,
        SUM(is_flagged_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, account_id ORDER BY is_flagged_flag, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_is_flagged_flag
    FROM valid
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach accounts attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        b.status,
        b.opened_date
    FROM enriched a
    LEFT JOIN accounts b
        ON a.account_id = b.id
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR txn_time > LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time, id) + INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM with_dims
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, status ORDER BY running_count_is_flagged_flag DESC, id) AS rn
        FROM islands
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
with_gaps_2 AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN txn_time - LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id) > INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM deduped
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        txn_type,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        running_count_is_flagged_flag,
        running_sum_is_flagged_flag,
        status,
        opened_date,
        burst_id,
        rn,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id_2
    FROM with_gaps_2
),
with_gaps_3 AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN txn_time - LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time, id) > INTERVAL 60 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM sessionized
),
islands_transactions AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps_3
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN burst_id >= 8 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS burst_id_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', opened_date) AS week_start,
    merchant,
    SUM(burst_id) FILTER (WHERE txn_type = 'CREDIT') AS credit_total_burst_id,
    AVG(burst_id) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CLOSED') AS closed_avg_burst_id,
    COUNT_IF(txn_type = 'REFUND') AS refund_events
FROM islands_transactions
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN burst_id >= 8 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', opened_date), merchant)
HAVING refund_events > 1
```

```python
lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("attr_key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    lines
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("status_code").over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key", "host").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)).alias("status_code_max_15m"),
        F.sum("status_code").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "log_ts"), "host").orderBy("status_code", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_status_code"),
        F.avg("latency_ms").over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key", "host").orderBy("latency_ms", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)).alias("latency_ms_avg_5"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").asc_nulls_first())).alias("latency_ms_cume_dist"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key", "host").orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc(), "id", "attr_key")).alias("status_code_bucket"),
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("log_ts")).orderBy("cumulative_status_code", "id", "attr_key")).alias("cumulative_status_code_bucket"),
    )
)

valid = (
    enriched
    .filter((~F.col("attr_key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("version"))) & (F.col("latency_ms_avg_5") > 736))
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "status_code",
        "attr_key",
        "attr_value",
        "status_code_max_15m",
        "cumulative_status_code",
        "latency_ms_cume_dist",
        "status_code_bucket",
        "cumulative_status_code_bucket",
        F.col("latency_ms_avg_5").cast("string").alias("latency_ms_avg_5_str"),
        F.round((F.col("status_code_max_15m") / F.col("status_code_bucket")), 2).alias("status_code_max_15m_per_status_code_bucket"),
    )
)

filtered = (

    .filter(F.col("attr_key").isNotNull() & (F.col("cumulative_status_code_bucket") < 8))
    .select(

        "log_ts",
        "status_code",
        "attr_key",
        "status_code_max_15m",
        "latency_ms_cume_dist",
        "cumulative_status_code_bucket",
        "latency_ms_avg_5_str",

        "log_ts",
        "attr_key",

        "resolved_attr_key",
        F.sum("new_group_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_id"),
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY sku_id ORDER BY moved_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        sku_id,
        session_no,
        MIN(moved_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(moved_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(moved_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(moved_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY sku_id, session_no
)
SELECT
    sku_id,
    session_end,
    events,
    duration_min,
```

```python
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("pressure").between(993, 995))
    .withColumn("status_bits_plus_temp_c", (F.col("status_bits") + F.col("temp_c")))
    .withColumn("temp_c_plus_status_bits", (F.col("temp_c") + F.col("status_bits")))
)

with_windows = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("temp_c").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("pressure", "id")).alias("prev_temp_c"),
        F.lag("humidity").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("pressure", "id")).alias("prev_humidity"),
        F.lead("humidity").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("pressure", "id")).alias("next_humidity"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("pressure", "id")).alias("event_seq"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("status_bits").desc(), "id")).alias("status_bits_bucket"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("prev_temp_c").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("temp_c", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_avg_prev_temp_c"),
        F.max("prev_temp_c").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("temp_c", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_max_prev_temp_c"),
        F.count("prev_temp_c").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("temp_c", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_count_prev_temp_c"),
        F.min("prev_temp_c").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("temp_c", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_min_prev_temp_c"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 1 HOUR")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = flagged.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

stats = (
    islands
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("status_bits_plus_temp_c") >= 75, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("status_bits_plus_temp_c_tier"),

)

        "dv_01_events",
```

```python
    df_tracks
    .filter((F.upper(F.trim(F.col("title"))).like("G%")) & (F.col("release_date").between(F.lit("2024-04-21").cast("date"), F.lit("2025-08-07").cast("date"))))
```
