```sql
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        cast(started_at as date) as started_at_day
    from sessions
    where browser = 'Safari'
),
deduped as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *
    from base
    qualify row_number() over (partition by customer_id order by started_at_day desc, id) = 1
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select customer_id, browser
    from deduped
    except all
    select customer_id, browser
    from sessions
    where country = 'DE'
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from deduped s
    inner join matched_keys k on s.customer_id = k.customer_id and s.browser = k.browser
),
not_flagged as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from reconciled s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from web_events ch
            where ch.session_id = s.id
              and ch.event_time <= s.started_at
        )
),
filtered as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        device,
        started_at,
        country,
        day(started_at) as started_at_day_2,
        case when device in ('tablet', 'desktop') then 'Priority' else 'Other' end as device_group
    from not_flagged
    where country is not null
      and browser is distinct from 'Edge'
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        dense_rank() over (partition by country order by started_at_day_2 desc nulls first) as started_at_day_2_dense_rank,
        avg(started_at_day_2) over (partition by device, country) as device_avg_started_at_day_2
    from filtered
)
select
    device,
    started_at,
    country,
    started_at_day_2,
    device_group,
    started_at_day_2_dense_rank
from scored
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_sessions
    .filter(F.col("browser") == "Safari")
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        F.col("started_at").cast("date").alias("started_at_day"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    base
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("started_at_day").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")

    deduped
    .select("customer_id", "browser")
    .exceptAll(

        .filter(F.col("country") == "DE")
        .select("customer_id", "browser")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")) & (F.col("s.browser") == F.col("k.browser")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
```

```python
    .filter((F.col("last_restock") > F.lit("2023-07-17").cast("date")) & F.col("quantity").between(136, 239))
    .withColumn("last_restock_month_end", F.last_day("last_restock"))
)

    cleaned
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("last_restock").desc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)

    .select("id", "store_id", "last_restock")
```

```python
w_hist = Window.orderBy(F.col("status_code_high").desc_nulls_first())

    df_app_logs

        "host",
```

```sql
        FROM covered
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
```

```sql
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        brand,
        price,
        cost,
        stock_qty,
        launch_date,
        supplier_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', launch_date) AS launch_date_period,
        COALESCE(brand, 'UNKNOWN') AS resolved_brand
    FROM products
    WHERE stock_qty = 398
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching order_item per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        x.unit_price,
        x.quantity
    FROM cleaned s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.unit_price, c.quantity
            FROM order_items c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.unit_price DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        brand,
        price,
        cost,
        launch_date,
        resolved_brand,
        unit_price,
        LEAD(price, 1) OVER w_recent AS next_price,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY stock_qty NULLS FIRST) AS stock_qty_percent_rank
    FROM latest_match
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY price, id)
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY launch_date DESC, id) AS row_num
    FROM scored
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        price,
        cost,
        launch_date,
        resolved_brand,
        next_price,
        stock_qty_percent_rank,
        SUM(stock_qty_percent_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY launch_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_stock_qty_percent_rank,
        AVG(next_price) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY next_price, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS next_price_avg_6_prior
    FROM ranked
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT category, id
    FROM metrics
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT category, id
    FROM products
    WHERE category = 'Books'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.category = k.category AND s.id = k.id
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, DATE_SUB(launch_date, 72) AS launch_date_minus_72d
    FROM reconciled
    WHERE cost BETWEEN 420 AND 650
),
summary AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
```

```sql
        total_ms_played,

    FROM stats
```

```sql
        id,
```
```sql
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        voltage,

    FROM meter_readings
```

```sql
    FROM cleaned

    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)

    FROM with_prev

sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY read_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        site_id,
        burst_id,
        MIN(read_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(read_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(kwh) AS session_kwh,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(read_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(read_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY site_id, burst_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    site_id,
    burst_id,
    session_end,
    event_count,
    session_kwh
FROM per_session
ORDER BY event_count DESC NULLS FIRST, burst_id
```

```python
    df_sessions
```

```sql
),
inbound_monthly AS (
    -- INBOUND rows per moved_at_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', moved_at) AS moved_at_month, COUNT(*) AS inbound_count, SUM(qty) AS inbound_total_qty
    FROM stock_moves
    WHERE move_type = 'INBOUND'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', moved_at)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.moved_at_month, b.moved_at_month) AS moved_at_month,
    COALESCE(a.outbound_count, 0) AS outbound_count,
    COALESCE(a.outbound_total_qty, 0) AS outbound_total_qty,
    COALESCE(b.inbound_count, 0) AS inbound_count,
    COALESCE(b.inbound_total_qty, 0) AS inbound_total_qty,
    COALESCE(a.outbound_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.inbound_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM outbound_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN inbound_monthly b
  ON a.moved_at_month = b.moved_at_month
ORDER BY moved_at_month
```

```python
outbound_monthly = (
    df_stock_moves
    .filter(F.col("move_type") == "OUTBOUND")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "moved_at").alias("moved_at_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("outbound_count"),
        F.sum("qty").alias("outbound_total_qty"),
    )
)

inbound_monthly = (
    df_stock_moves
    .filter(F.col("move_type") == "INBOUND")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "moved_at").alias("moved_at_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("inbound_count"),
        F.sum("qty").alias("inbound_total_qty"),
    )
)

result = (
    outbound_monthly.alias("a")
    .join(inbound_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.moved_at_month") == F.col("b.moved_at_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.moved_at_month"), F.col("b.moved_at_month")).alias("moved_at_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.outbound_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("outbound_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.outbound_total_qty"), F.lit(0)).alias("outbound_total_qty"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.inbound_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("inbound_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.inbound_total_qty"), F.lit(0)).alias("inbound_total_qty"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.outbound_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.inbound_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
```

```sql
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        term,
        score,

        enrolled_at
    FROM enrollments

    FROM filtered
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_enrolled_at IS NULL OR enrolled_at > prev_enrolled_at + INTERVAL 60 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY term ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        term,
        session_id,
        MIN(enrolled_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(enrolled_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(enrolled_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(enrolled_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY term, session_id
),
totals AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_start) AS session_start_month,
        term,
        session_id,
        MAX(session_start) AS last_session_start,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(term)) AS term_list
    FROM per_session
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
    HAVING MAX(duration_min) > 48.0
)
-- Subtotals with ROLLUP
SELECT
    term,
    session_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT term) AS distinct_terms,
    ROUND(STDDEV(session_id), 2) AS stddev_session_id
FROM totals
```

```python
    .select(

        "score",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",
    )
)

with_prev = filtered.withColumn("prev_enrolled_at", F.lag("enrolled_at").over(Window.partitionBy("term").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")))

    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_enrolled_at").isNull() | (F.col("enrolled_at") > F.col("prev_enrolled_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))

per_session = (
```

```sql
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter enrollments
    SELECT
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        term,
        score,
        grade_status
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE student_id IS NOT NULL
),
term_stats AS (
    -- Avg score per term
    SELECT term, AVG(score) AS avg_score
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY term
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT s.*, g.avg_score, ROUND(s.score - g.avg_score, 2) AS score_minus_avg
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN term_stats g ON g.term = s.term
    WHERE s.score > g.avg_score
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per grade_status, term
    SELECT
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        term,
        score,
        grade_status,
        avg_score,
        score_minus_avg
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY grade_status, term ORDER BY avg_score DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM above_average
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
annotated AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        GREATEST(avg_score, score_minus_avg) AS greatest_avg_score_score_minus_avg,
        CONCAT(grade_status, '#', CAST(id AS STRING)) AS grade_status_ref
    FROM deduped
    WHERE course_id <= 4
),
with_details_course AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.student_id,
        s.course_id,
        s.term,
        s.score,
        s.grade_status,
        s.avg_score,
        s.greatest_avg_score_score_minus_avg,
        s.grade_status_ref,
        c.level AS course_level,
        st.major AS student_major,
        st.cohort AS student_cohort
    FROM annotated s
    JOIN courses c ON c.id = s.course_id AND c.dept IS NOT NULL
    LEFT JOIN students st ON st.id = s.student_id
    WHERE c.level = 'advanced'
),
detail_rows_enrollments AS (
```

```python
    df_enrollments

    above_average

        "s.term",
        "s.score",
        "s.grade_status",
        "s.avg_score",
        "s.greatest_avg_score_score_minus_avg",
        "s.grade_status_ref",
        F.col("c.level").alias("course_level"),
        F.col("st.major").alias("student_major"),
        F.col("st.cohort").alias("student_cohort"),
    )
)

detail_rows_enrollments = (
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        tariff,
        valid_from,
        valid_to,
        rate,
        CONCAT(tariff, '#', CAST(id AS STRING)) AS tariff_ref,
        DATE_FORMAT(valid_to, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:00') AS valid_to_label
    FROM tariff_windows
    WHERE valid_from < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-09 04:00:00'
      AND rate > 5.2
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        tariff,
        valid_from,
        valid_to,
        rate,
        valid_to_label,
        ROUND(AVG(rate) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(valid_to) ORDER BY valid_to, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS rate_avg_4,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY tariff) AS rows_in_tariff,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(valid_to), tariff ORDER BY rate, id) AS rate_tercile,
        ROUND(rate / NULLIF(SUM(rate) OVER (PARTITION BY tariff), 0), 4) AS rate_share_of_tariff
    FROM scoped
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per tariff
    SELECT
        id,
        tariff,
        valid_from,
        valid_to,
        rate,
        valid_to_label,
        rate_avg_4,
        rows_in_tariff,
        rate_tercile,
        rate_share_of_tariff
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tariff ORDER BY rows_in_tariff DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM with_trends
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
)
-- Final projection

    id,
    tariff,
    valid_from,
    rate,
    rows_in_tariff,
    rate_tercile,
    rate_share_of_tariff,
    LEAST(rows_in_tariff, rate_share_of_tariff) AS least_rows_in_tariff_rate_share_of_tariff
FROM latest
```

```sql
    EXCEPT

SELECT
    txn_type,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(amount, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS amount_quartiles,
    STDDEV_SAMP(amount) AS amount_stddev,

ORDER BY txn_type DESC
```

```python
    df_transactions
    .select("txn_type")
    .subtract(
        df_transactions
        .filter(F.col("amount") < 2600)
        .select("txn_type")
    )

    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.txn_type") == F.col("k.txn_type")), "inner")
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
```

```python
    df_enrollments
```

```python
w_student_id_enrolled_at_year = Window.partitionBy("student_id", F.year("enrolled_at")).orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")

        F.round(F.col("enrolled_at_quarter") - F.avg("enrolled_at_quarter").over(Window.partitionBy("student_id")), 2).alias("enrolled_at_quarter_vs_student_id_avg"),

        F.sum("enrolled_at_quarter").over(Window.partitionBy("course_id")).alias("course_id_sum_enrolled_at_quarter"),
        (F.col("enrolled_at_quarter") - F.lag("enrolled_at_quarter").over(w_student_id_enrolled_at_year)).alias("enrolled_at_quarter_change"),
        F.max("enrolled_at_quarter").over(Window.partitionBy("course_id", "enrolled_at_quarter").orderBy(F.col("score").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("enrolled_at_quarter_max_4"),

)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("country", "segment").orderBy("age", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_customers
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("clean_name", F.trim("name"))
    .withColumn("segment_filled", F.coalesce("segment", F.lit("N/A")))
)

ranked = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy(F.col("credit_limit").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "email",
        "country",
        "segment",
        "is_active",
        "credit_limit",
        "age",
        "clean_name",
        "segment_filled",
    )
)

metrics = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "is_active",
        "credit_limit",
        "segment_filled",
        F.max("credit_limit").over(w_grp).alias("running_max_credit_limit"),
        F.count("credit_limit").over(w_grp).alias("running_count_credit_limit"),
        F.min("credit_limit").over(w_grp).alias("running_min_credit_limit"),
        F.avg("credit_limit").over(w_grp).alias("running_avg_credit_limit"),
        F.stddev_samp("credit_limit").over(Window.partitionBy("segment")).alias("segment_stddev_samp_credit_limit"),
    )
)

not_flagged = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("x"), (F.col("x.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.shipping_fee") > 12), "left_anti")
)

stats = (
    not_flagged
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("segment_stddev_samp_credit_limit") >= 17648, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("segment_stddev_samp_credit_limit_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("running_count_credit_limit") >= 18, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("running_count_credit_limit_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("segment_stddev_samp_credit_limit", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("segment_stddev_samp_credit_limit_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.avg("running_avg_credit_limit"), 2).alias("avg_running_avg_credit_limit"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.percentile_approx("credit_limit", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("credit_limit_quartiles"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "segment_stddev_samp_credit_limit_tier",
        "running_count_credit_limit_tier",
        "avg_running_avg_credit_limit",
    )
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared = df_plays.filter(F.col("is_skipped"))

    prepared.alias("s")
    .join(df_tracks.alias("t"), F.col("t.id") == F.col("s.track_id"), "inner")
    .join(df_listeners.alias("l"), F.col("l.id") == F.col("s.listener_id"), "left")
    .filter(F.upper(F.trim(F.col("t.title"))).like("E%"))
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.listener_id",
        "s.track_id",
        "s.played_at",
        "s.ms_played",
        "s.device",
        "s.is_skipped",
        F.col("t.title").alias("track_title"),
        F.col("l.birth_year").alias("listener_birth_year"),
    )
)

w_is_skipped_by_ms_played = Window.partitionBy("is_skipped").orderBy(F.col("ms_played").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
sequenced = (
    with_parent
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("ms_played") - F.avg("ms_played").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("played_at"))), 2).alias("ms_played_vs_played_at_month_avg"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("track_id").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("played_at")))).alias("distinct_track_id_in_played_at_month"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("is_skipped").orderBy(F.col("played_at").desc())), 3).alias("played_at_percent_rank"),
        F.round(F.col("listener_birth_year") / F.nullif(F.sum("listener_birth_year").over(Window.partitionBy("device", "track_id")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("listener_birth_year_share_of_device_track_id"),
        F.nth_value("played_at", 2).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("played_at"), "listener_id").orderBy("ms_played", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_played_at"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("is_skipped").orderBy(F.col("ms_played").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count"),
        F.round(F.col("listener_birth_year") - F.avg("listener_birth_year").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("played_at"))), 2).alias("listener_birth_year_vs_played_at_month_avg"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("played_at"), "listener_id").orderBy("ms_played", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_2"),
        F.max("listener_birth_year").over(Window.partitionBy("device", "track_id")).alias("device_track_id_max_listener_birth_year"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("is_skipped").orderBy(F.col("played_at").desc())).alias("played_at_dense_rank"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("played_at"))).alias("rows_in_played_at_month"),
        F.rank().over(w_is_skipped_by_ms_played).alias("ms_played_rank"),
        F.lead("played_at").over(Window.partitionBy("track_id", "device").orderBy(F.col("listener_birth_year").desc(), "id")).alias("next_played_at"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("listener_id").over(Window.partitionBy("device", "track_id"))).alias("distinct_listener_id_in_device_track_id"),
        F.sum("listener_birth_year").over(Window.partitionBy("device", "track_id")).alias("device_track_id_sum_listener_birth_year"),
    )
)

w_all_by_ms_played_ties = Window.orderBy("ms_played")
w_listener_id_track_id = Window.partitionBy("listener_id", "track_id")
windowed = (
    sequenced
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last("played_at_percent_rank", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("running_count_2").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_played_at_percent_rank"),
        F.max("rows_in_played_at_month").over(Window.orderBy("ms_played", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("rows_in_played_at_month_max_7"),

)
```

```sql
WITH withdrawn_by_student AS (
    -- WITHDRAWN rows per student_id
    SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS withdrawn_count, SUM(score) AS withdrawn_total_score
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE grade_status = 'WITHDRAWN'
    GROUP BY student_id
),
fail_by_student AS (
    -- FAIL rows per student_id
    SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS fail_count, SUM(score) AS fail_total_score
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE grade_status = 'FAIL'
    GROUP BY student_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.student_id, b.student_id) AS student_id,
    COALESCE(a.withdrawn_count, 0) AS withdrawn_count,
    COALESCE(a.withdrawn_total_score, 0) AS withdrawn_total_score,
    COALESCE(b.fail_count, 0) AS fail_count,
    b.fail_total_score,
    COALESCE(a.withdrawn_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.fail_count, 0) AS withdrawn_count_minus_fail_count
FROM withdrawn_by_student a
FULL OUTER JOIN fail_by_student b
  ON a.student_id = b.student_id
ORDER BY student_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

withdrawn_by_student = (
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("grade_status") == "WITHDRAWN")
    .groupBy("student_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("withdrawn_count"),
        F.sum("score").alias("withdrawn_total_score"),
    )
)

fail_by_student = (
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("grade_status") == "FAIL")
    .groupBy("student_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("fail_count"),
        F.sum("score").alias("fail_total_score"),
    )
)

result = (
    withdrawn_by_student.alias("a")
    .join(fail_by_student.alias("b"), F.col("a.student_id") == F.col("b.student_id"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.student_id"), F.col("b.student_id")).alias("student_id"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.withdrawn_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("withdrawn_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.withdrawn_total_score"), F.lit(0)).alias("withdrawn_total_score"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.fail_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("fail_count"),
        F.col("b.fail_total_score"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.withdrawn_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.fail_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("withdrawn_count_minus_fail_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("student_id")
)
```

```sql
    FROM flagged

screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM sessionized
    WHERE burst_id > (SELECT AVG(burst_id) FROM sessionized)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    requester_id,
    agent_id,
    opened_at,
    channel,
    csat,
    opened_at_date,
    prev_opened_at,
    starts_session,
    burst_id,
```

```python
    .select(
```

```python
        F.last("valid_to").over(Window.orderBy("valid_from", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_valid_to"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)

enriched = (
    df_suppliers
    .withColumn("rating_avg_2_prior", F.avg("rating").over(Window.orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)))
    .withColumn("country_max_rating", F.max("rating").over(Window.partitionBy("country")))
    .withColumn("rating_avg_5", F.avg("rating").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("rating_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc_nulls_first())))
    .withColumn("country_stddev_samp_rating", F.stddev_samp("rating").over(Window.partitionBy("country", "city")))
)

not_flagged = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.category") != "Home"), "left_anti")
)

filtered = (
    not_flagged
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.trim("supplier_name").alias("clean_supplier_name"))
)

latest_match = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.cost").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.country",
        "s.city",
        "s.rating",
        "s.rating_avg_2_prior",
        "s.country_max_rating",
        "s.rating_avg_5",
        "s.clean_supplier_name",
        F.col("c.cost"),
    )
)

enriched_suppliers = (
    latest_match
    .select(
        "id",
        "country",
        "city",
        "rating",
        "rating_avg_2_prior",
        "clean_supplier_name",
        "cost",
        F.first("rating_avg_5", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_rating_avg_5"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc(), "id")).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

not_flagged_suppliers = (

    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.supplier_id").isNull()), "left_semi")
)

stats = (
    not_flagged_suppliers
    .groupBy("city")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("rating") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "London", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("rating_per_london"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("country") == "US", F.col("rating")).otherwise(0)).alias("us_rating"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Bangkok", 1)).alias("bangkok_rows"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "city",
        "rating_per_london",
        "bangkok_rows",
        F.when(F.col("city").rlike("^(London|Chiang Mai)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").when(F.col("city").rlike("^(Bangkok|New York)$"), "CORE").otherwise("GROUP_A").alias("city_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("rating_per_london").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

```sql
        e.grade_status AS enrollment_grade_status
    FROM filtered_enrollments s
    LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.course_id = s.course_id
),
derived AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(enrollment_score * 0.25, 2) AS enrollment_score_adj
    FROM line_level
),
enriched AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN enrollment_score >= 69.6 THEN 'A' WHEN enrollment_score >= 26.2 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS enrollment_score_tier,

    WHERE course_id IS NOT NULL
),
windowed AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        course_id,
        score,
        term_or_unknown,
        score_adj,
        enrollment_id,
        enrollment_score,
        enrollment_score_adj,
        enrollment_score_tier,
        enrollment_grade_status_ref,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY enrollment_id ORDER BY score_adj NULLS LAST, id, enrollment_id), 3) AS score_adj_percent_rank,
        NTH_VALUE(score_adj, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY enrollment_id ORDER BY score_adj NULLS LAST, id, enrollment_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_score_adj
    FROM enriched
),
grouped AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        term_or_unknown,
        ROUND(STDDEV(score_adj), 2) AS stddev_score_adj,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
        COUNT(DISTINCT term_or_unknown) AS distinct_term_or_unknowns,
        ROUND(SUM(second_score_adj), 2) AS total_second_score_adj
    FROM windowed
    GROUP BY term_or_unknown
)
SELECT term_or_unknown, total_second_score_adj
FROM grouped
ORDER BY total_second_score_adj DESC NULLS FIRST, term_or_unknown DESC
```

```sql
    FROM base_readings
    WINDOW w_read_at_year_quality AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(read_at), quality)
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT read_at, quality, read_at_year_quality_sum_kwh
    FROM with_trends

    AVG(read_at_year_quality_sum_kwh)
```

```sql
    FROM ranked
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.fail_count, 0) AS fail_count,
    b.fail_total_score,
    COALESCE(a.pass_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.fail_count, 0) AS net_count

ORDER BY enrolled_at_month
```

```sql
    FROM sessions
```

```sql
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY browser, customer_id ORDER BY started_at NULLS FIRST, id) AS latest_rank
    FROM filtered

),
prev_events AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY started_at, id) AS prev_started_at
    FROM deduped
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_started_at IS NULL OR started_at > prev_started_at + INTERVAL 14 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM prev_events
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT customer_id, browser
    FROM islands
    EXCEPT
    SELECT customer_id, browser
    FROM sessions
    WHERE country IN ('DE', 'JP', 'SG')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM islands s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.customer_id = k.customer_id AND s.browser = k.browser
),

)

    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(device)) AS device_list,
    MAX(burst_id) FILTER (WHERE device = 'tablet') AS tablet_max_burst_id
FROM not_flagged
```

```sql
            ORDER BY c.txn_time DESC, c.id DESC
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base_tickets = (
    df_tickets
    .filter(~F.col("priority").isin("P3", "P2"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "agent_id",
        "opened_at",
        "closed_at",
        "priority",
        "channel",
        "csat",
    )
)

w_agent_id = Window.partitionBy("agent_id")
w_priority = Window.partitionBy("priority")
w_all_by_csat = Window.orderBy(F.col("csat").desc(), "id")
sequenced = (
    base_tickets
    .select(
        "*",
        F.size(F.collect_set("channel").over(Window.partitionBy("priority"))).alias("distinct_channel_in_priority"),
        F.round(F.col("csat") - F.avg("csat").over(w_agent_id), 2).alias("csat_vs_agent_id_avg"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("closed_at") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("closed_at").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("csat").desc(), "id")))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_closed_at"),
        F.last("csat").over(Window.partitionBy("priority").orderBy(F.col("closed_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_csat"),
        F.min("csat").over(w_priority).alias("priority_min_csat"),
        F.round(F.col("csat") / F.nullif(F.sum("csat").over(w_agent_id), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("csat_share_of_agent_id"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("priority").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id"))).alias("distinct_priority_in_agent_id"),
        F.round(F.col("csat") - F.avg("csat").over(Window.partitionBy("priority")), 2).alias("csat_vs_priority_avg"),
        F.round(F.avg("csat").over(Window.partitionBy("priority").orderBy(F.col("closed_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("csat_avg_7"),
        (F.col("csat") - F.lag("csat").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("csat").desc(), "id"))).alias("csat_change"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("csat").asc_nulls_last(), "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.lag("csat").over(w_all_by_csat).alias("prev_csat"),
    )
)

top_per_group = (
    sequenced
    .filter(F.col("seq_no") <= 3)
    .drop("seq_no")
)

with_trends = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "csat_vs_agent_id_avg",

        "csat_avg_7",

        F.round(F.avg("csat_share_of_agent_id").over(Window.partitionBy("last_csat")), 2).alias("last_csat_avg_csat_share_of_agent_id"),
        F.round(F.col("last_csat") / F.nullif(F.sum("last_csat").over(Window.partitionBy("last_csat")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("last_csat_share_of_last_csat"),
        F.last("csat_vs_agent_id_avg").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("csat_vs_priority_avg").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_csat_vs_agent_id_avg"),
    )
)

result = (

    .select(

        "csat_vs_agent_id_avg",
```

```python
    .join(
```
```python
        df_tariff_windows.alias("tw"),
        (F.col("tw.tariff") == F.col("st.tariff"))
        & (F.col("r.read_at") >= F.col("tw.valid_from"))
        & (F.col("r.read_at") < F.col("tw.valid_to")),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
```
